codex.quest.et_comets.comethorn.text.0: It can be tamed. A strange friendship.
codex.quest.et_comets.comethorn.title: Comethorn
codex.quest.et_comets.crystal.text.0: Crystal on the creator, portal from comet interdimensional bricks, click — and the sky turns pink.
codex.quest.et_comets.crystal.title: Comets Crystal
codex.quest.et_comets.enter.text.0: First extraterrestrial soil level. Between islands — void, and it doesn't forgive.
codex.quest.et_comets.enter.title: First Step
codex.quest.et_comets.ice.text.0: Cryothermic ice and what lives in it.
codex.quest.et_comets.ice.title: Icelands
A banshee in a ruined house, comet fleas in the crater, and the story of the war in which Volcanech wiped this world off the map.
codex.quest.et_comets.quest_comets.title: Comets Quest
codex.quest.et_comets.skylite.text.0: Skylite from ore, aerolite from chests. Both go into the Purgatorium crystal.
codex.quest.et_comets.skylite.title: Skylite and Aerolite
codex.quest.et_comets.tree.text.0: Fell a comet tree with the Tragedy Axe — and the tree answers. The dimension's first boss; from it drops hellfire for the Purgatorium altar.
codex.quest.et_comets.tree.title: Terrible Tree
codex.quest.et_darkness.activate.text.0: The Totem of Eternity. Everything stronger, everything more dangerous. Reversible.
codex.quest.et_darkness.activate.title: Activation
codex.quest.et_darkness.humanity.text.0: Grows from the wicked, falls from the good. Governs essences and opens two bosses that otherwise don't exist.
codex.quest.et_darkness.humanity.title: Humanity
codex.quest.et_darkness.nox_luc.title: Noxifer and Luciden
codex.quest.et_darkness.rings_dark.title: Rings of Darkness
codex.quest.et_darkness.super.text.0: The advancement is called 'Suicidal Man'. That's a warning.
codex.quest.et_darkness.super.title: Super Duper Darkness
codex.quest.et_eden.adam_eve.text.0: 'Are you really the first?' Hidden bosses of the garden.
codex.quest.et_eden.adam_eve.title: Adam and Eve
codex.quest.et_eden.aragotium.text.0: A mythic metal. Component of the Volcanech crystal.
codex.quest.et_eden.aragotium.title: Aragotium
codex.quest.et_eden.crystal_eden.title: Eden Crystal
codex.quest.et_eden.enter_eden.text.0: Third soil level. The first world where you're welcome.
codex.quest.et_eden.enter_eden.title: Gates of Eden
codex.quest.et_eden.jaghax.text.0: 'Tell me what you want?' he'll ask. Answer with a weapon.
codex.quest.et_eden.jaghax.title: Jaghax
codex.quest.et_eden.scorched.title: Scorched Lands
codex.quest.et_eden.sunfurry.text.0: Their armor, weapons, trade. The Drink of the Sun — for messiahs and the outsiders who earned it.
codex.quest.et_eden.sunfurry.title: Sunfurry
codex.quest.et_eden.sunstone.text.0: Shards from Nyetet — into a whole stone. The stone — onto the portal in the End.
codex.quest.et_eden.sunstone.title: Sunstone
codex.quest.et_farming.bugs.text.0: Bugs are bait. Rare bug — rare fish.
codex.quest.et_farming.bugs.title: Bug Net
codex.quest.et_farming.fishing_nets.text: The net fishes on its own; the nether one — in lava.
codex.quest.et_farming.machines.text.0: One waters, the other fertilizes. Both without you.
codex.quest.et_farming.machines.title: Machines
codex.quest.et_farming.pets.text.0: Raccoons, gultravs, tarkos, comethorn, the ravrite queen. A raccoon can be petted.
codex.quest.et_farming.pets.title: Pets
codex.quest.et_farming.pot.text.0: Plant on top, soil in the slot, from level five — water and fertilizer. Nether and extraterrestrial pots — for other worlds' flora.
codex.quest.et_farming.pot.title: Gardener's Pot
codex.quest.et_gear.accessories.text.0: Celestial sphere, watching sphere, thinking stone, echo anchor, immunity amulets.
codex.quest.et_gear.accessories.title: Accessories
codex.quest.et_gear.armors_early.text.0: Charged copper, broken bones, forest ranger, treasure hunter.
codex.quest.et_gear.armors_early.title: Early Armors
codex.quest.et_gear.armors_late.text.0: Truadamantite, chthonic, orichalcum, priest, ergosphere, aetherium.
codex.quest.et_gear.armors_late.title: Late Armors
codex.quest.et_gear.armors_mid.text.0: Dark mage, warlock, whaler, mucus guts, runic.
codex.quest.et_gear.armors_mid.title: Mid Armors
codex.quest.et_gear.fun.text.0: Smartphone, fursuits, lava lamps, energy drink, gravicycle. The mod knows how to laugh.
codex.quest.et_gear.fun.title: Curiosities
codex.quest.et_gear.ranged.text.0: Atimite's crossbow, Rocket's gun, Bowapril, the Arkemer railgun.
codex.quest.et_gear.ranged.title: Ranged
codex.quest.et_gear.storage_et.text.0: A chest that walks with you.
codex.quest.et_gear.storage_et.title: Portable Chests
codex.quest.et_gear.weapons.text.0: Ammit's staff, Khonshu's staff, Mixcohuatl's weapon, the Bloody Anchor, the Cephalopods Slayer, Hoz de Muerte, Archangel's Wings — from blueprints dug from the ground.
codex.quest.et_gear.weapons.title: Weapons
codex.quest.et_intro.bard.text.0: A coin — a song. You can take the guitar for yourself.
codex.quest.et_intro.bard.title: Bard
codex.quest.et_intro.coins.text.0: Ancient and gold. The mod traders' currency, in chests and mob pockets.
codex.quest.et_intro.coins.title: Coins
codex.quest.et_intro.journal.text.0: A notebook for promises. Quests come from NPCs in Eternal Town and dimension settlements; the journal remembers conditions and rewards even when you've forgotten who asked.
codex.quest.et_intro.journal.title: Journal
codex.quest.et_intro.miguel.text.0: He sells boss summons and knows the story of the burned village, Vivid and a girl named Eternity. Not everything he says is true. All of it matters.
codex.quest.et_intro.miguel.title: Miguel the Storyteller
codex.quest.et_intro.notice.text.0: The board is the mod's textbook and the place level points are spent. Read them all: sorcery, archaeology, fishing, Darkness mode, crystal recipes — all described there, written by those who made it.
codex.quest.et_intro.notice.title: Notice Board
codex.quest.et_intro.quests_all.text.0: Overworld, Nether, End, every dimension and the Aftermath line. Finish everything — and hear the story whole, from the first village to the last record.
codex.quest.et_intro.quests_all.title: All Quests
codex.quest.et_intro.starter.text.0: A chest with what helps on day one.
codex.quest.et_intro.starter.title: Starter Kit
codex.quest.et_intro.town.text.0: A town of musicians, built by one man for one girl. Here live Aeter, Miguel the Storyteller, trophy traders and a bard who plays for a coin. Everything starts here.
codex.quest.et_intro.town.title: Eternal Town
codex.quest.et_karvat.crystal_kar.title: Karvat Crystal
codex.quest.et_karvat.enter_kar.title: Ancient Dimension
codex.quest.et_karvat.gods.text.0: Enicrih — the true king. Haciru — the mage. Hirots — disease. Ikkorh — life and death. Arla — strength. Each its own altar, its own shard of power after the fight.
codex.quest.et_karvat.gods.title: Gods of Karvat
The stolen god Gulibeg and what's left of him — yours.
codex.quest.et_karvat.karvat_quest.title: Divine Power
codex.quest.et_karvat.khogachi.title: Khogachi
codex.quest.et_karvat.quetzal.text.0: The feathered serpent and his priest.
codex.quest.et_karvat.quetzal.title: Quetzalcoatl
codex.quest.et_nether_end.end_quest.text: A fruit that cures portal disease — the companion of all who walk between worlds.
codex.quest.et_nether_end.endacea.title: Endacea
codex.quest.et_nether_end.nether_res.tex: Bonespur, nether fish, fire moss — into crystals and alchemy.
codex.quest.et_nether_end.nether_tower.t: A tower with a clock piglins couldn't use and locks whose keys are with the overseers of the Blazing Wastes. Who built it, you'll learn in Amber.
codex.quest.et_nether_end.tsar.text.0: The one with the Crystal Crown. And his warlock.
codex.quest.et_nether_end.tsar.title: Tsar of Piglins
The Ravrite Queen in a hive underground, the Dreadful Sapling from fertile soil, Grotesterk — the legacy of the Xaxxas, of whom you know nothing yet.
codex.quest.et_overworld.bosses_ow.title: Overworld Bosses
codex.quest.et_overworld.interdim.text.0: The workbench where five rarities and a sorcery level fold into a crystal of another world. The return ticket is the first thing to make on it: it brings you home from anywhere and asks only one level.
codex.quest.et_overworld.interdim.title: Interdimensional Creator
codex.quest.et_overworld.moons.text.0: The blood moon angers mobs, the blue floods the world with slimes, the clown one — a circus till dawn. Totems summon, loot is unique, survival not guaranteed.
codex.quest.et_overworld.moons.title: Lunar Events
codex.quest.et_overworld.ores.text.0: Tin, silver, tungsten, cobalt, ruby, uranium, venetium. Cobalt is the first step past diamond. Uranium warms without protection — and not kindly.
codex.quest.et_overworld.ores.title: New Ores
codex.quest.et_overworld.seasonal.text.0: Ekatebrina — three tiers and an ice serpent. The Halloween Spirit — in October.
codex.quest.et_overworld.seasonal.title: Seasonal Bosses
codex.quest.et_overworld.vivid.text.0: The one who burned the village, if Miguel is believed. The mod's first truly hard fight; the oathsword after it serves long.
codex.quest.et_overworld.vivid.title: Vivid
A portal of Purgatorium bricks. It's always dark inside.
codex.quest.et_purgatorium.hellrock.text: Asteroid stone to the altar, hellfire from the Tree in hand — and the altar gives hellrock. Without it the door down won't open.
codex.quest.et_purgatorium.lapsidian.tex: This world's metal. Crystals and gear.
codex.quest.et_purgatorium.nyetet.text.0: He was a hero once. Rune on the altar — and he comes to remind you. Sunstone shards pour from him.
codex.quest.et_purgatorium.nyetet.title: Nyetet, the Fallen Titan
codex.quest.et_purgatorium.quest_purg.te: Five Leviathan Blossoms for a dying brother. And the truth about why Heveline is here.
codex.quest.et_purgatorium.rock_blaze.te: Altar, fire, boss. From it — the first part of the Fallen Rune.
codex.quest.et_purgatorium.rune.text.0: First part — from the Rock Blaze, second — from local mob drops, third — from the Wanderer, who doesn't sell it for money.
codex.quest.et_purgatorium.rune.title: Fallen Rune
codex.quest.et_rayana.crystal_ray.title: Rayana Crystal
codex.quest.et_rayana.enter_ray.text.0: Fourth soil level. Hyacinthum gold underfoot.
codex.quest.et_rayana.enter_ray.title: Jungles of Rayana
codex.quest.et_rayana.kraken.text.0: Big, tentacled, from the Mucunfectio quarantine zone.
codex.quest.et_rayana.kraken.title: Infected Kraken
codex.quest.et_rayana.pterion.text.0: The eye on the Bloody Cult altar in the Aede temple — find it by stone pillars rising from the ground. Pterion descends himself. 'Flying Terror' in the Aede tongue.
codex.quest.et_rayana.pterion.title: Pterion
codex.quest.et_rayana.vampirism.text.0: Vampires drop the Bloody Stone. From it and local ores — the Bloody Eye.
codex.quest.et_rayana.vampirism.title: Vampirism
codex.quest.et_rayana.volkihar.text.0: The vampire lord's power — in your hands.
codex.quest.et_rayana.volkihar.title: Volkihar
From brushing and from shredding blueprints.
codex.quest.et_skills.archery.text.0: From bows and thrown weapons. Opens the jewelry table and the archer's glove.
codex.quest.et_skills.archery.title: Archery
codex.quest.et_skills.digging.text.0: From ore. Higher level — extra chunks more often.
codex.quest.et_skills.digging.title: Digging
codex.quest.et_skills.fear.text.0: Only in Eternal Darkness. From mobs under fear; gives speed, strength and night vision by level.
codex.quest.et_skills.fear.title: Fear
codex.quest.et_skills.fishing.text.0: Fishing — from rare fish; catching — from insects in the net. Insects become bait; the rarer the bug, the better the catch.
codex.quest.et_skills.fishing.title: Fishing and Catching
codex.quest.et_skills.growing.text.0: From plants in the gardener's pot. From level five — water and fertilizer.
codex.quest.et_skills.growing.title: Growing
codex.quest.et_skills.level.text.0: Raise a skill — get a point. Spend a point — raise a skill. A circle that turns in your favor.
codex.quest.et_skills.level.title: Player Level
codex.quest.et_skills.slaying.text.0: From mobs: points equal their health divided by twenty. Opens emblems.
codex.quest.et_skills.slaying.title: Slaying
codex.quest.et_skills.sorcery_skill.text: From rune stones, essences and artifacts. Without a sorcery level a dimension crystal won't assemble — that's the mod's main lock.
codex.quest.et_skills.speech.task.0: Trade with an Eternal Tales merchant
codex.quest.et_skills.speech.title: Speech
codex.quest.et_sorcery.altars.text.0: Arei, Arla, Arahulum, Haciru, Hirots, Ikkorh, Enicrih, bloody, purgatory, hellish, royal. Each calls its own.
codex.quest.et_sorcery.altars.title: Altars
codex.quest.et_sorcery.astral.text.0: Enchantments the regular table lacks, and levels above the usual cap.
codex.quest.et_sorcery.astral.title: Astral Enchanter
codex.quest.et_sorcery.books.text.0: Glowing, dolphin's grace, portal disease and dozens more — single-use and reusable.
codex.quest.et_sorcery.books.title: Spell Books
codex.quest.et_sorcery.cauldron.text.0: More than twenty runes — into the cauldron on soul sand, and out come essences: the currency that buys artifacts and charges the matrix.
codex.quest.et_sorcery.cauldron.title: Extraction Cauldron
codex.quest.et_sorcery.matrix.text.0: The matrix lays runes on armor and weapons. Runic armor is what you put into it.
codex.quest.et_sorcery.matrix.title: Runic Matrix
codex.quest.et_sorcery.rituals.text.0: Activators summon spirits, bring luck, cast curses, drop stars. Blueprints — at the jewelry table; copies — at the printer.
codex.quest.et_sorcery.rituals.title: Rituals
codex.quest.et_sorcery.runes.text.0: Rune stones are broken with a pickaxe; the Rune Prospector enchant multiplies drops. Forest, desert, nether, comet, eden — by world. The bag stores them.
codex.quest.et_sorcery.runes.title: Runes
codex.quest.et_ultimate.aetherium.text.0: The Arkemers' energy: armor, tubes, weapons.
codex.quest.et_ultimate.aetherium.title: Aetherium
codex.quest.et_ultimate.aftermath.text.0: What happened after. The Flecheresha Stone trial — New Game+.
codex.quest.et_ultimate.aftermath.title: Aftermath
codex.quest.et_ultimate.arkemer_tech.tex: Quarry, shredder, gravicycle, smartphone. The 'Aleph' railgun and the 'Heavenbreaker' — their weapons.
codex.quest.et_ultimate.blackhole.text.0: Stabilized. Miniature. In your pocket. Armor forged in the ergosphere.
codex.quest.et_ultimate.blackhole.title: A Black Hole in Your Hands
codex.quest.et_ultimate.emblems.title: Emblems
codex.quest.et_ultimate.enter_ult.title: The Ultimate World
codex.quest.et_ultimate.hammer.text.0: The multitool, the divine pickaxe and hoe.
codex.quest.et_ultimate.hammer.title: Hammer of Eternity
codex.quest.et_ultimate.ultimate_items.r: The absolute ceiling of Eternal Tales
codex.quest.et_ultimate.ultimate_items.t: The Ultimate One, The Ultimate Two, the Gauntlet of the Destinies, the Heart of the Elements, the First Prism, the Order of the Universe. There are no items beyond.
codex.quest.et_unahzaal.armor_un.text.0: Chthonic, orichalcum chthonic, Grand Priest. The ceiling of protection.
codex.quest.et_unahzaal.armor_un.title: Unahzaal Armor
codex.quest.et_unahzaal.astral.text.0: A crystal component. The restored astral is a reward for what comes after.
codex.quest.et_unahzaal.astral.title: Damaged Astral
Amber, Comets, Eden, Volcanech and the damaged astral — into one crystal.
codex.quest.et_unahzaal.crystal_un.title: Unahzaal Crystal
codex.quest.et_unahzaal.enter_un.title: The Multiverse
codex.quest.et_unahzaal.eye.title: Eye of Unahzaal
codex.quest.et_unahzaal.gifts.title: Gifts of Unahzaal
codex.quest.et_unahzaal.tetra.text.0: The false god and the last choir.
codex.quest.et_unahzaal.tetra.title: Tetragrammaton
codex.quest.et_unahzaal.unahzaal.text.0: Journey's end. In Eternal Darkness the fight is different, and so is the reward — the Calamity Ring.
codex.quest.et_unahzaal.unahzaal.title: Unahzaal
codex.quest.et_volcanech.arahulum.text.0: All the familiar faces. His eye stays with the winner.
codex.quest.et_volcanech.arahulum.title: Arahulum
A mushroom. A boss. A mushroom boss.
codex.quest.et_volcanech.brimstone.title: Brimstone Agaric
codex.quest.et_volcanech.enter_vol.title: The Molten World
codex.quest.et_volcanech.golem.text.0: He's very hot. Not a metaphor.
codex.quest.et_volcanech.golem.title: Volcanic Golem
codex.quest.et_volcanech.sulfur.text.0: The most destructive thing before the atomic bomb. There's an atomic bomb too.
codex.quest.et_volcanech.sulfur.title: Sulfur Explosives
Not everyone here wants war. The road to Amber begins here.
codex.quest.et_volcanech.vol_quest.title: Defection
codex.quest.fd_kitchen.board.text.0: The board takes things apart: a knife gives cuts of meat, an axe planks, a pickaxe rubble.
codex.quest.fd_kitchen.board.text.1: It's also the cheapest way to skin and butcher a carcass.
codex.quest.fd_kitchen.board.title: Cutting Board
codex.quest.fd_kitchen.crops.text.0: Tomatoes, cabbage, onions, rice. Wild versions grow in matching biomes — that's where to start.
codex.quest.fd_kitchen.crops.text.1: Rice goes in shallows, tomatoes need a trellis.
codex.quest.fd_kitchen.crops.title: New Crops
codex.quest.fd_kitchen.feast.text.0: Feast dishes go on a table and feed several players: roast chicken, pie, honey-glazed ham, baked cod.
codex.quest.fd_kitchen.feast.title: Feast
codex.quest.fd_kitchen.knife.text.0: The knife slices ingredients on the board and serves as a light weapon. Flint, iron, gold, diamond, netherite.
codex.quest.fd_kitchen.knife.title: Knife
codex.quest.fd_kitchen.pot.text.0: The pot cooks soups and stews over a campfire. A recipe — up to six ingredients plus a container (bowl, bottle).
codex.quest.fd_kitchen.pot.text.1: Put several pots on one long campfire — you get a kitchen.
codex.quest.fd_kitchen.pot.title: Cooking Pot
codex.quest.fd_kitchen.rope.text.0: Rope lets you hang items, and 'bundles' dry the harvest.
codex.quest.fd_kitchen.rope.title: Rope and Hanging
codex.quest.fd_kitchen.skillet.text.0: The skillet fries faster than a furnace and works right in your hands over a fire source. Also a decent weapon that sets things ablaze.
codex.quest.fd_kitchen.skillet.title: Skillet
codex.quest.fd_kitchen.soil.text.0: Organic compost is made in the composter from organics, straw from wheat. Rich soil speeds growth and needs no watering.
codex.quest.fd_kitchen.soil.title: Rich Soil
codex.quest.fd_kitchen.storage_fd.text.0: Cabinets, baskets and crates for the harvest. A crate packs nine into one block.
codex.quest.fd_kitchen.storage_fd.title: Food Storage
codex.quest.fd_kitchen.stove.text.0: The stove fries up to six items at once and shows them on its surface.
codex.quest.fd_kitchen.stove.title: Stove
codex.quest.final_bridges.adventure_brid: Tech gear makes the adventure mods much easier: MekaSuit takes Cataclysm boss hits, the IE drill digs the Twilight Forest, the Ad Astra jet suit replaces Aether wings.
And the reverse: Eternal Tales and Aether artifacts boost survival on dangerous production floors.
codex.quest.final_bridges.autocraft_brid: Any item in the pack, one click
The autocrafter works with more than a crafting table: it feeds an IE crusher, Create crafters or a Mekanism enrichment chamber and takes the result.
One order in the grid runs a chain through three mods.
The colony mechanic can make tech-mod parts once taught. The courier delivers, and the warehouse joins the RS network.
Result: the colony supplies your factory, and the factory the colony.
codex.quest.final_bridges.defense_bridge: IE turrets guard the base from mobs, MineColonies guards protect the colony from raids, Big Cannons artillery with radar — from players and air targets.
All three run on the shared grid.
codex.quest.final_bridges.energy_bridge2: Three new lines joined the old three: Powah, Create: New Age and Ad Astra. They all speak FE, and an Immersive Engineering wire reaches any of them.
The practical upshot: put the generator where fuel is cheap and the machines where it suits you. Distance is a cable problem.
codex.quest.final_bridges.fuel_chain.tex: IE's plant oil and ethanol, Create Addition's bioethanol and Mekanism's biofuel all come from the same thing — crops.
The IE cloche and a Create farm cover the raw material entirely.
codex.quest.final_bridges.logistics_brid: Create 6 and Refined Storage solve one problem differently: the first hauls physical packages, the second teleports data.
A sensible compromise: RS at the base, Create packages between outposts and the colony.
codex.quest.final_bridges.magic_tech_bri: Botania turns iron into manasteel, Ars Nouveau automates drop collection with critters, Apotheosis hangs affixes on Mekanism tools.
None of these mods knows about the others — but you do, and that's your edge.
codex.quest.final_bridges.ore_chain.text: Three mods give three processing tiers: Create's millstone and wheels (×2), IE's crusher (×2 with byproducts), Mekanism's chain (×5).
Optimal: mine with the IE excavator or Mekanism digital miner, process in Mekanism, distribute through Refined Storage.
codex.quest.final_bridges.resource_bridg: Mystical Agriculture closes mining for good: every metal in the pack, Mekanism osmium and Powah uraninite included, grows in a field.
Industrial Foregoing's laser drill does the same from bedrock, and Mekanism's digital miner from the ground. Three ways not to swing a pickaxe.
codex.quest.final_bridges.rot_to_fe.rewa: A single power system for the whole base
codex.quest.final_bridges.rot_to_fe.text: Create Addition's alternator turns rotation into FE. From there energy goes into IE capacitors and Mekanism cubes.
The reverse is the electric motor: FE becomes rotation again, so Create machines run off a Mekanism reactor.
codex.quest.final_bridges.storage_bridge: Refined Storage's external storage links Create vaults, Mekanism bins, IE silos and MineColonies racks to the network.
Colony warehouse, factory stock and autocrafting become one inventory.
codex.quest.final_bridges.transport_brid: Create trains haul ore from the mine, Aeronautics airships carry cargo over rough terrain, Mekanism teleporters and waystones carry you.
Create's portable interfaces and Create Addition's energy interface unload transport automatically.
codex.quest.final_goals.goal_adventure.t: All three Aether dungeons, the full Twilight Forest boss chain and the Lamp of Cinders in hand.
codex.quest.final_goals.goal_all.text.0: Ten peaks climbed. The pack leads you nowhere further — from here you lead it.
codex.quest.final_goals.goal_all.text.1: A good next goal: build what no mod foresaw but their parts allow.
codex.quest.final_goals.goal_all.title: All at Once
codex.quest.final_goals.goal_colony.text: A level-five colony with every building, the full research tree and a garrison that repels any raid.
codex.quest.final_goals.goal_create.text: A fully automated factory on gauges, a railway between sites, and a flying base on Create Aeronautics.
codex.quest.final_goals.goal_eternal.tex: All nine dimensions, victory over Unahzaal, the Ultimate World and the Arkemers' ultimate items.
codex.quest.final_goals.goal_hunt.text.0: All ten Cataclysm bosses and a full set of Ignitium armor. A trophy hall with no empty spots.
codex.quest.final_goals.goal_hunt.title: Peak of the Hunt
codex.quest.final_goals.goal_ie.text.0: An excavator on a surveyed vein, an arc furnace, diesel generators on home-made biodiesel and the full engineer's toolkit.
codex.quest.final_goals.goal_ie.title: Peak of Immersive Engineering
The Gaia Guardian in his second form, the Dice of Fate and at least one relic. Flower magic taken to its end.
codex.quest.final_goals.goal_magic.title: Peak of Magic
codex.quest.final_goals.goal_mek.text.0: Fusion reactor, steam turbine, SPS with antimatter and a fully built MekaSuit.
codex.quest.final_goals.goal_mek.title: Peak of Mekanism
A tier four rocket, a jet suit and a base on Glacio with an oxygen distributor. Another star system, properly settled.
codex.quest.final_goals.goal_space.title: Peak of Space
codex.quest.final_goals.goal_storage.tex: A network with 64k disks, wireless access and autocrafting of any depth — or a full set of Mekanism QIO drives.
codex.quest.hunt_apotheosis.affixes.text: Dropped gear now has a rarity and affixes: grey common, green uncommon, blue rare, purple epic and orange mythic. A common piece carries one or two properties and no sockets at all; a mythic one carries four properties, two effects, a special ability and up to four sockets.
First thing to understand: the old rule that a diamond sword beats an iron one no longer holds. A mythic iron one hits harder.

You don't throw away the finds you don't want: the salvaging table turns them into a material of the same rarity, from mysterious scrap metal to a godforged pearl. That is the currency for the rest of this chapter.
codex.quest.hunt_apotheosis.augment.text: Reforging throws the whole item again; the augmenting table works one affix at a time. A chosen affix rises by a quarter or gets rerolled, and the rest stay exactly as they were.

The price matches. Two sigils of enhancement and experience worth well over two hundred levels for a single improvement. The sigils are mixed on godforged pearls, and those only come from salvaging mythic gear.
This is where the lottery ends and the jeweller's work begins: the item is brought to the shape you want, one affix at a time.
codex.quest.hunt_apotheosis.deepshelf.te: A dormant deepshelf infused gives seventy. Past that you need an Ancient City: echo shards raise the ceiling to seventy-five, and eighty has exactly one road — kill the Warden for its tendril.
Sculkshelves built on that tendril give ten Eterna each, fifteen Quanta or Arcana, and an extra clue in the preview.
Eighty is the level where vanilla enchantments stop being interesting and the mod's own start showing up: Berserker's Fury, Boon of the Earth, Endless Quiver, Life-Mending.
codex.quest.hunt_apotheosis.enchanting.t: Apotheosis' table replaces the vanilla one and shows three numbers instead of one. Eterna is the ceiling: whatever you have gathered is the level you can enchant to. Quanta is the spread: the higher it runs, the further the result wanders around the level you picked. Arcana is rarity: it tilts the weights toward expensive enchantments and adds more of them.

Bookshelves stop being interchangeable. Hellshelves give Eterna and Quanta, seashelves Eterna and Arcana, the geode shelf cuts away the negative half of the spread, the sightshelf adds clues, and the beeshelf drops Eterna by thirty to buy a hundred Quanta.
Level thirty comes from fifteen ordinary shelves. Past that, the real building starts.
codex.quest.hunt_apotheosis.gems.text.0: Gems slot into sockets and grant bonuses: damage, speed, protection, luck. Each has six steps of purity, from cracked to perfect, and the gap between the ends of that scale is enormous.
codex.quest.hunt_apotheosis.gems.text.1: The cutting table raises purity by one step for gem dust and a rarity material. The higher the step, the dearer it gets: flawless to perfect costs nine dust and three godforged pearls.
codex.quest.hunt_apotheosis.gems.text.2: A gem case holds thirty-two thousand stones of every kind and can cut them inside itself.
codex.quest.hunt_apotheosis.gems.title: Gems
codex.quest.hunt_apotheosis.hundred.text: The last twenty levels cost more than everything before them combined. Infused breath, an infusion of dragon's breath at eighty Eterna, opens the endshelves and ninety.
The hundred comes from a single shelf: the draconic endshelf, which wants a dragon head from the outer End. It carries twenty Eterna and removes the ceiling outright.

And even that is not enough: the Eterna ceiling is cut by Apotheosis' world tier. On Haven the table will not pass thirty no matter how many shelves surround it. A real hundred exists only on Pinnacle.
At the top waits the Library of Alexandria, a vault for enchantments up to level thirty-one, built only by infusion at a hundred Eterna and a hundred Arcana.
codex.quest.hunt_apotheosis.infusion.tex: At forty-five Eterna the table stops merely enchanting and starts creating. Infusion is a craft performed inside the table itself, checking all three numbers at once.

That is how a hellshelf becomes infused, a seashelf becomes infused, a dormant deepshelf becomes a deepshelf. The same road gives budding amethyst, a real trident out of an inert one, and the extraction tome, which strips enchantments without destroying the item.
Every next recipe demands a stronger table than the last. Infusion is a ladder where each rung builds the one above it.
codex.quest.hunt_apotheosis.invaders.tex: Now and then an ordinary spawn is replaced by an Apothic Invader: a pillar of light, a sound and a line in the chat. It is a named mob carrying the full stat load of its rarity, and killing it is harder than it looks.
Every invader wears exactly one affixed item, and that item drops guaranteed, with the invader's name on it. On top of that comes a gem or a sigil of malice, the only way to get one.
There are no invaders on Haven at all. They start on the second tier, and the higher the world, the more often they come.
codex.quest.hunt_apotheosis.leads.text.0: A flimsy ender lead catches animals, a plain one catches almost anything, and the occult one binds what it caught to a spawner.
codex.quest.hunt_apotheosis.leads.text.1: The plain lead is infused from the flimsy one; the occult from the plain, but only with a witch already inside it, and only at seventy-five Eterna with eighty-five Quanta.
codex.quest.hunt_apotheosis.leads.text.2: It is the most direct way to get a spawner for the mob you want rather than the one you were given.
codex.quest.hunt_apotheosis.leads.title: Ender Lead
codex.quest.hunt_apotheosis.reforge.text: The reforging table rolls an item again from scratch, and what decides the outcome is not the table but what you put into it: the rarity material you feed it is the rarity you get back. The simple table covers common through rare; the full one opens epic and mythic.

Three results are offered; the second costs twice as much, the third three times. A mythic roll runs to fifty levels, three materials and five sigils of rebirth, and it can still hand you the wrong thing.
The salvaging table pulls materials and dust out of gear you don't need — that's what funds all this alchemy.
Sigils are applied at a smithing table: the item in the base slot, the sigil in the upgrade slot. The sigil of socketing adds a socket while the item has fewer than two; the sigil of withdrawal pulls every gem back out; the sigil of unnaming strips an ornate name.

The sigil of rebirth never touches the item directly. It is fuel for the reforging table, and the higher the rarity, the more of them a single roll burns. The sigil of enhancement feeds the augmenting table, which raises a chosen affix by a quarter or rerolls that one affix without disturbing the rest.
Two sigils cannot be bought: the sigil of malice drops from bosses, and the sigil of supremacy is the prize for the hundredth wave of an endless gateway.
codex.quest.hunt_apotheosis.sigils.title: Sigils
codex.quest.hunt_apotheosis.spawners.tex: A spawner can be carried off with a chain and then rebuilt with runes: drop the darkness requirement, remove the player check, speed it up, widen its radius.
That turns a dungeon into a farm, and a farm into a source of experience and affixed gear.
A full set of uncommon gear and the head of an Apothic Invader open the third tier. Rare becomes the most common find, and the Nether grows its own gems: the Ravenous Blood Lord and the Incandescent Inferno.
codex.quest.hunt_apotheosis.tier_frontie: Frontier asks for a full set of affixed gear: helmet, chestplate, leggings, boots and a weapon, all affixed. In return green becomes the standard find and epic stops being impossible.
From this tier the overworld gems start appearing: the Earth, the Royal Family, the Verdant Ruin.
codex.quest.hunt_apotheosis.tier_haven.t: Apotheosis divides the world into five tiers, and CTRL+T shows the current one. Haven is the first: only grey and green drop, rare slips through about once in twenty-five finds, and epic and mythic do not exist at all.
The tier opens on its own the moment you hold your first affixed item.
codex.quest.hunt_apotheosis.tier_pinnacl: The last tier costs a full set of epic gear and the head of the Ender Dragon. After it, common, uncommon and all the low-end rubbish disappear from the tables: only rare, epic and mythic remain, and mythic is every fourth find.
There is nowhere left to climb. All that remains is cutting gems to perfection and reforging the same gear until it comes out flawless.
A full set of rare gear and a slain Wither lift the world to the second-to-last tier. Grey vanishes from the tables entirely, epic drops more often than everything else combined, and the End starts yielding Endersurge gems.
codex.quest.hunt_apotheosis.tomes.text.0: Tomes steer enchanting: the tome of the archers rolls only bow enchantments, the tome of chestplates only chestplate ones. That turns the lottery into a choice.
codex.quest.hunt_apotheosis.tomes.text.1: The other direction is stripping enchantments. The scrap tome takes half and destroys the item, the improved one takes everything and still destroys it, and the extraction tome takes everything and leaves the item whole.
codex.quest.hunt_apotheosis.tomes.text.2: A prismatic web in an anvil removes curses. An ordinary library stores enchantments up to level sixteen and hands them back one level at a time, each level costing twice the last.
codex.quest.hunt_apotheosis.tomes.title: Tomes
Half the useful things in Alex's Mobs are built from what its own creatures drop. Two tarantula hawk wings and an elytra give an elytra that never breaks. Seven centipede legs give leggings you climb walls in.
Eight crocodile scutes speed up your swimming, eight rocky shells turn a sprint into a roll, three lost tentacles and a crossbow become a grapple.
The vine lasso catches any creature, hostile ones included, and carries it in your pocket.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.beast_gear.title: Gear from the Hunt
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.chemx.text.0: Mutant Monsters works two ways. Mutants spawn on their own, but at a twentieth of the usual weight, so the meeting is random and always badly timed.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.chemx.text.1: The second way is reliable. A thick potion brewed with an endersoul hand, a hulk hammer, a creeper shard or a mutant skeleton skull becomes Chemical X. Splash it on a zombie, skeleton, creeper, enderman or snow golem and you get the mutant version. A pig becomes a spider pig, but only if you feed it a fermented spider eye first.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.chemx.text.2: A mutant zombie is durable three times over: it stands up again and again until the fallen body is set alight with flint and steel. It drops the hulk hammer, which sends a seismic wave along the ground.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.chemx.title: Chemical X
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.combat.task.0: Read: every weapon has its own arc and its own reach
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.combat.text.0: Better Combat throws out the aim ray and counts a hit as the weapon's volume intersecting the target's hitbox. A sword sweeps a hundred and twenty degrees, a dagger or claymore a hundred and fifty, a glaive up to a hundred and eighty.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.combat.text.1: Reach is now an attribute and is printed in the tooltip: a dagger reaches two and a half blocks, a sword three, a scythe three and a half, a spear four. A sword has three attacks in its combo, a katana four, and the combo resets after three idle seconds.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.combat.text.2: Two-handed weapons will not tolerate a shield in the off-hand; any one-handed weapon, on the other hand, can be held in both, striking alternately and a fifth faster.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.combat.text.3: Cataclysm's weapons are mapped by a separate datapack: the Incinerator counts as a claymore, the Soul Render as a halberd, Ceraunus as an anchor, and the forges as hammers.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.combat.title: The New Combat
Alex's Mobs adds well over a hundred creatures, and remembering who lives where and eats what is hopeless. The dictionary answers both questions: a book, green dye and any item from the mod.

Twenty-one animals can be tamed. A grizzly follows honey, a gorilla bananas, a capuchin rides your shoulder, a kangaroo carries your things in its pouch, and a laviathan ferries four passengers across lava.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.dictionary.title: Animal Dictionary
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.frostmaw.text.0: A Frostmaw sleeps in snowy biomes: two hundred and fifty health and an ice crystal in its paw. Wake it head-on and it swallows the crystal; kill it and it gives the crystal back.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.frostmaw.text.1: There is a second road: creep within two blocks of the paw while invisible and simply take the crystal. Then a music disc drops from the body instead, but only while it rains.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.frostmaw.text.2: The crystal never breaks and restores itself. Holding right-click raises a blizzard, and after three seconds it applies Frozen, a full lock on all actions for two and a half seconds. Fire ends it early.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.frostmaw.title: Frostmaw
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.locators.text.0: Cachalot whales sometimes beach themselves. Save one and you get ambergris, and ambergris with two whale teeth and an iron ingot builds the echolocator, which points at the nearest cave.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.locators.text.1: Four ender pearls turn it into the endolocator, which hunts for stronghold portal frames. No more digging for a stronghold at random.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.locators.title: Echolocation
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.mutant_gear.text: A mutant skeleton falls apart on death: skull, ribs, limbs, pelvis, shoulder pads. Those build an armor set that protects about as well as iron, repairs with bone blocks, and carries three hidden traits: the boots grant permanent Jump Boost, the leggings Speed, and the skull on your head makes any bow fire like Multishot.
A mutant enderman leaves an endersoul fragment. Drop an eye of ender beside it and you get the endersoul hand: right-click teleports you where you're looking with no fall damage.
A charged creeper minion egg, when it hatches wrong, yields a creeper shard, which detonates around its owner, throwing back everything alive and poisoning the owner as payment.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.sculptor.text.0: A monastery stands on the mountain peaks, and its keeper, Tongbi the Sculptor, is not hostile to you. Bluffs live inside: forty-five health and eighteen damage, the most dangerous rank-and-file mobs in the mod. They drop bluff rods.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.sculptor.text.1: Hand a rod to the Sculptor and he sets a trial: climb sixty blocks in four hundred seconds, placing and breaking nothing, no teleports, no flight. Pure parkour.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.sculptor.text.2: The reward for finishing is guaranteed: the Earthrend Gauntlet. It lifts boulders out of the ground, tunnels through earth and pushes its owner up on a pillar of soil.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.sculptor.text.3: You can kill the Sculptor instead, but then one random item of five drops, and the gauntlet is one chance in five.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.sculptor.title: The Sculptor's Trial
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.tame.text.0: An elephant is tamed with an acacia blossom, a bald eagle with fish oil, a tarantula hawk with a spider eye, a mantis shrimp with tropical fish, a warped toad with mosquito larva.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.tame.text.1: Some are not tamed but calmed. A tiger fed meat grants the Tiger's Blessing, froststalkers follow whoever wears their helmet, and the undead stop noticing the owner of an unsettling kimono.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.tame.text.2: The falconry glove lets you carry an eagle on your arm and loose it at a target; the hood lets you steer it directly.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.tame.title: Taming
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.transmute.text.0: A nether star, two farseer arms and three obsidian make a table that converts whole stacks of items into one another for experience.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.transmute.text.1: It is not automation and not a factory. It is a way to unload the chests of whatever piled up too high and get what ran short.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.transmute.title: Transmutation Table
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.umvuthi.text.0: An Umvuthana grove stands in the savanna. Arrive without a mask and the whole village, Umvuthi the Sunbird included, comes at you. Arrive in a mask taken from a raptor and Umvuthi sells the Sun's Blessing for seven blocks of gold, and gives it free every time after.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.umvuthi.text.1: The blessing lasts an hour and grants four moves with an empty hand: Sunstrike and Solar Flare for free, Solar Beam for five minutes of the reserve, and Supernova for everything that is left.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.umvuthi.text.2: Kill Umvuthi anyway and the Sol Visage remains, a helmet that never breaks. Wearing it, any Umvuthana mask turns into an ally on a right-click, and you can keep ten of those at once.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.umvuthi.title: Umvuthi
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.voidworm.text.0: A crimson mosquito larva goes into a capsid, the container you take off an enderiophage. The larva becomes a mysterious worm.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.voidworm.text.1: The worm is thrown into the void of the End. Out of it rises the Void Worm, the mod's largest opponent, which splits apart as you fight it.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.voidworm.text.2: It drops an eye and mandibles, and those with two netherite ingots build the dimensional carver: a portal back to your spawn point from anywhere. The shattered version, crafted inside a capsid, reaches a million blocks.
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.voidworm.title: Void Worm
codex.quest.hunt_beasts.wroughtnaut.text: Mowzie's Mobs hides a wrought chamber underground, and Ferrous Wroughtnaut stands inside it. He does not move until someone comes close, and he will not be hit from the front: a two-hundred-and-twenty-degree arc is sealed.
The one window is the moment after he slams the axe into the ground and the blade sticks. Strike from behind, and only then.
Victory pays an axe and a helmet, both unbreakable. The axe cuts in a wide arc, and crouching turns the swing into a shockwave along the ground.
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.acropolis.tex: The storm eye leads to a warm ocean and makes you look up: the Acropolis floats in the sky, at height two hundred. Getting there is a problem of its own.
Inside are Clawdian with its claw, the Hippocamtus, the Cindaria and Scylla herself: three hundred and ninety health and eighteen damage.

She sheds Lacrima and Essences of the Storm, and out of those you forge Ceraunus, an anchor you throw, and Astrape, a spear that fires lightning. Astrape and the Infernal Forge on the fusion anvil give Brontes, which can be thrown.
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.all_bosses.te: Eight bosses: the Netherite Monstrosity, the Ender Guardian, the Harbinger, the Ancient Remnant, the Leviathan, Scylla, Maledictus and Ignis.
The mod keeps score and grants the advancement when the list runs out. It's one of the longest hunts in the pack.
If you want to kill one of them twice, a Boss Respawner is left where five of them fell: click it with the right eye and the owner comes back.
The flame eye leads to the nether wastes, to a round arena over lava. Ignis waits until Burning Ashes are placed on the Altar of Fire; the Ignited Revenants walking nearby carry them.

The fight runs in three phases, at two thirds and one third of his health. His damage scales off your maximum health, so a big health pool will not save you. He breaks the floor, he holds a shield, and only a void rune punches through it.
After his death Ignited Berserkers start appearing in nether fortresses. And his ignitium makes armor that walks on lava and the Incinerator, a claymore that sets everything in front of it alight.
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.burning.title: Burning Arena
The void eye points at a citadel in the End. Ender Golems and Endermaptera patrol it, and deep inside the Altar of Void raises the Ender Guardian: three hundred and thirty-three health and twenty armor, the highest of any boss in the mod.
The Guardian drops the Gauntlet of Guard — a right-click drags every living thing in sight toward you. The golems drop the Void Core.
The core is not a trophy but a part. You will need it to turn the Infernal Forge into the Void Forge.
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.citadel.title: Ruined Citadel
The mech eye leads underground, thirty blocks below zero, to a plant that has run without people for a very long time. The Prowler and the Watcher walk the floors, and in the far hall lies the Harbinger's deactivated frame.

It will not wake by itself: the frame has to be touched with a nether star. After that three hundred and ninety health stand up and come for you, and everything on the floor labelled EMP switches on with them.

The Harbinger drops a block of witherite, nine ingots at once. That is the mod's key metal: the mechanical fusion anvil, the wither assault shoulder weapon, the laser gatling and the meat shredder all come from it.
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.factory.title: Ancient Factory
The cursed eye leads to snowy plains, to a prison ringed by an abandoned spire, temple and village. Draugr and Aptrgangr walk inside, and the latter always drop the Strange Key, which opens the Door of Seal.
Behind the door stands the Cursed Tombstone. It charges for about a minute before it can be clicked, and then it releases Maledictus: four hundred and twenty health, a cursed rider.

His metal, cursium, makes the ghost armor: the helmet sees through walls, the chestplate revives its wearer on five hearts, the leggings give a chance to ignore a hit outright, the boots soften every fall. Cursium also forges the Soul Render and the Cursed Bow.
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.frosted.title: Frosted Prison
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.fusion.text.0: The mechanical fusion anvil does what no workbench can: it melts two finished trophies into a third that otherwise does not exist.
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.fusion.text.1: Infernal Forge and Void Core give the Void Forge, which fires a fan of void runes. Gauntlet of Guard and Bulwark of the Flame give the Gauntlet of Bulwark. Gauntlet of Guard and Sandstorm in a Bottle give the Gauntlet of Maelstrom. The shoulder weapon plus a void core turns void.
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.fusion.text.2: The list of fusions is finite, and each one wants trophies from different bosses. That is Cataclysm's real progression tree.
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.fusion.title: Fusion
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.ignitium.text: The upgrade template takes four nether bricks, four blaze powder and a vanilla netherite template; after that it's a smithing table and ignitium over netherite.

The helmet lays a Blazing Brand on a keypress, the leggings answer a hit with flame, the boots walk lava like stone. The chestplate merges with an elytra on the fusion anvil — the only way to fly without taking your armor off.
Cursium armor is its opposite: where ignitium takes the hit, cursium lets you avoid it. Keep both full sets in a chest and swap by situation.
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.pets.text.0: Three bosses leave more than weapons behind. The netherite effigy releases the Ministrosity, tamed with a lava power cell. The remnant skull calls the Modern Remnant, tamed with a sniffer egg. The abyssal egg gives the Baby Leviathan.
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.pets.text.1: All three fight for you and, unlike wolves, survive meeting a boss.
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.pets.title: Pets
The desert eye leads to a pyramid where the Necklace of the Desert lies under suspicious sand. The Ancient Remnant sleeps beside it and reacts to nothing at all until someone clicks it with that necklace.
Then come four hundred and fifty health, twenty-five damage and the curses of the desert. Victory pays out a Sandstorm in a Bottle, the Remnant Skull and a block of ancient metal.
The bottle is more than a weapon: on the fusion anvil it turns the Cursed Bow into the Wrath of the Desert and the Gauntlet of Guard into the Gauntlet of Maelstrom.
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.pyramid.title: Cursed Pyramid
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.root.text.0: The mod scatters abandoned spires, temples and villages across the world — you'll stumble on them without looking. Inside are black steel and ancient metal: the gear you wear to the first boss.
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.root.text.1: The first accessories come from there too: the vitality ankh, the berserker soul amulet, the ring of the grudged. The belt of the beginner takes two leather and an iron ingot and opens a talisman slot.
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.root.text.2: The Explorer's Compass finds any of the mod's structures by name. Craft an eye instead, though: eight different eyes each lead to their own structure, the way an eye of ender leads to a stronghold.
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.root.title: First Find
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.soulforge.tex: The monstrous eye leads into the Nether, to the Soul Forge. The Netherite Monstrosity sleeps there: six hundred health, twenty-five damage a swing and a habit of pounding the ground hard enough to throw you off it.
It wakes on its own the moment you come close. Killing it is the earliest feat available and the door into the rest of the mod, because it drops the Infernal Forge.
The Forge is a pickaxe with four damage and nearly three thousand durability, and a right-click on a block hits everything around it. Both the Void Forge and Brontes grow out of it later.
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.sunken.text.0: The abyss eye points at a city on the floor of a deep ocean. Deeplings live there, and the Coralssus, and on the Altar of Abyss the Leviathan: four hundred health and complete invulnerability out of water.
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.sunken.text.1: You summon it with an abyssal sacrifice: a nautilus shell, an athame from a deepling priest, crystallized coral, and one block each of diamond, emerald, iron, gold and amethyst with a heart of the sea alongside.
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.sunken.text.2: Before the fight, visit the Altar of Amethyst in the same city: it turns amethyst crab meat into the blessed kind, and that grants immunity to Darkness, Abyssal Fear and Abyssal Burn. Without it you fight blind.
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.sunken.text.3: The Leviathan drops the Tidal Claws — right-click fires a grapple, left-click strikes with a tentacle.
codex.quest.hunt_cataclysm.sunken.title: Sunken City
codex.quest.ie_chemistry.bottling.text.0: Bottles, buckets, canisters — on a conveyor, no hands.
codex.quest.ie_chemistry.bottling.title: Bottling Machine
codex.quest.ie_chemistry.cloche.text.0: A glass bell under which anything grows: seed, soil, water, power — and harvest without fields. Works with IE hemp and Farmer's Delight crops.
codex.quest.ie_chemistry.cloche.title: Garden Cloche
codex.quest.ie_chemistry.diesel.text.0: The mod's strongest generator. Roars so loud you need earmuffs, eats fuel, and doesn't ask if you're ready for that much energy.
codex.quest.ie_chemistry.diesel.title: Diesel Generator
A polymer from chemical waste. Advanced parts and armor.
codex.quest.ie_chemistry.duroplast.title: Duroplast
Anything that grows ferments to ethanol. Sugar cane best of all.
codex.quest.ie_chemistry.fermenter.title: Fermenter
codex.quest.ie_chemistry.mixer.text.0: Concrete, potions by the bucket, solutions for processing.
codex.quest.ie_chemistry.mixer.title: Industrial Mixer
codex.quest.ie_chemistry.refinery_ie.tex: Ethanol with oil — biodiesel. High-power is meaner.
codex.quest.ie_chemistry.squeezer.text.0: Seeds to oil, plants to juice, pulp to fuel.
codex.quest.ie_chemistry.squeezer.title: Squeezer
codex.quest.ie_gear.buzzsaw.text.0: Fells trees. With the right blade — not only trees.
codex.quest.ie_gear.buzzsaw.title: Buzzsaw
codex.quest.ie_gear.chemthrower.text.0: Creosote burns, acid eats, water douses. Against crowds.
codex.quest.ie_gear.chemthrower.title: Chemthrower
codex.quest.ie_gear.drill_ie.text.0: Three by three per pass, on energy. A steel head lasts. Upgrades at the workbench: waterproof, tank, area.
codex.quest.ie_gear.drill_ie.title: Drill
codex.quest.ie_gear.misc_ie.text.0: Floodlight, electric lantern, chunk loader, maintenance kit.
codex.quest.ie_gear.misc_ie.title: Odds and Ends
codex.quest.ie_gear.powerpack.text.0: Powers everything handheld. The charging station stays home.
codex.quest.ie_gear.powerpack.title: Powerpack
codex.quest.ie_gear.railgun.text.0: Rods of any metal on energy. Hold the button — the charge grows.
codex.quest.ie_gear.railgun.title: Railgun
codex.quest.ie_gear.revolver.text.0: Assembled from parts by blueprint. AP, explosive, incendiary, buckshot, wolfpack, potion. Upgrades — electromagnet, cylinder, dual.
codex.quest.ie_gear.revolver.title: Revolver
codex.quest.ie_gear.shaders.text.0: Skins for weapons and machines. From bags and from the defeated.
codex.quest.ie_gear.shaders.title: Shaders
codex.quest.ie_gear.skyhook.text.0: Hook a taut cable and fly along it. A cableway between bases — a minute instead of ten.
codex.quest.ie_gear.skyhook.title: Skyhook
codex.quest.ie_gear.steel_armor.text.0: Between iron and diamond, from what you have tons of.
codex.quest.ie_gear.steel_armor.title: Steel Armor
codex.quest.ie_gear.turret.text.0: The gun turret eats revolver rounds, the chem one fluid. A target list, energy, and the base defends itself.
codex.quest.ie_gear.turret.title: Turrets
codex.quest.ie_machines.arc.text.0: Electrodes descend, metal flares. Steel faster than the blast furnace, scrap back into ingots. Graphite electrodes burn out and need replacing.
codex.quest.ie_machines.arc.title: Arc Furnace
codex.quest.ie_machines.assembler.text.0: Three crafting recipes at once from a shared buffer. The auto workbench does the same from a blueprint.
codex.quest.ie_machines.assembler.title: Assembler
codex.quest.ie_machines.conveyor.text.0: Plain, dropper, extract, vertical, splitter, covered. The sorter divides the flow, the batcher counts.
codex.quest.ie_machines.conveyor.title: Conveyors
Five by three by three, toothed rollers, a roar. Doubles ore and grinds anything dropped on top — including mobs that walk badly.
codex.quest.ie_machines.crusher_ie.title: Crusher
codex.quest.ie_machines.excavator.text.0: A house-sized bucket wheel turns slowly over the vein, and ore pours onto the conveyor. The vein thins but never ends. It's the machine everything else is built for.
codex.quest.ie_machines.excavator.title: Excavator
codex.quest.ie_machines.press.text.0: Molds aren't consumed: plates, rods, gears, wire, casings, packing. Make a mold once — and forever.
codex.quest.ie_machines.press.title: Metal Press
codex.quest.ie_machines.sample.text.0: Under every chunk lies a vein. Survey tools sample by eye, the drill precisely. The core sample shows what's there and what's left.
codex.quest.ie_machines.sample.title: Ore Survey
codex.quest.ie_machines.storage.text.0: A silo — a mountain of one item. A tank — a lake of one fluid.
codex.quest.ie_machines.storage.title: Storages
codex.quest.ie_power.capacitor.text.0: A hundred thousand, a million, four million. Sides set with the screwdriver: in, out, none.
codex.quest.ie_power.capacitor.title: Capacitors
codex.quest.ie_power.dynamo.text.0: The dynamo spins anything: a water wheel in a current, a windmill up high. The wheel needs flowing water its full height, the windmill needs sky.
codex.quest.ie_power.dynamo.title: Dynamo and Water Wheel
codex.quest.ie_power.lightning.text.0: A tower waiting for a storm. One strike — and the capacitors are full for a week.
codex.quest.ie_power.lightning.title: Lightning Rod
codex.quest.ie_power.safety.text.0: The Faraday suit against current, earmuffs against the diesel's roar, the breaker switch against everything at once. The voltmeter shows what you did wrong.
codex.quest.ie_power.safety.title: Safety
codex.quest.ie_power.thermo.text.0: Ice on one side, lava on the other — and current flows from the difference. Little, but forever.
codex.quest.ie_power.thermo.title: Thermoelectric Generator
codex.quest.ie_power.transformer.text.0: LV to MV, MV to HV. Direction — by which side the wire connects.
codex.quest.ie_power.transformer.title: Transformers
codex.quest.ie_power.windmill_ie.text.0: Blades and sails. Higher is stronger, rain is weaker.
codex.quest.ie_power.windmill_ie.title: Windmill
codex.quest.ie_power.wire_hv.text.0: Steel, 32768 per tick, across kilometers on poles. A relay is an intermediate post that eats nothing. A power line over the forest is the prettiest thing in IE.
codex.quest.ie_power.wire_hv.title: High Voltage
codex.quest.ie_power.wire_lv.text.0: Copper, 2048 per tick. Connector on the machine, wire from connector to connector with a right-click. Insulated — touchable. Bare — not.
codex.quest.ie_power.wire_lv.title: Low Voltage
codex.quest.ie_power.wire_mv.text.0: Electrum, 8192 per tick. Gold and silver in the blast furnace or mixer.
codex.quest.ie_power.wire_mv.title: Medium Voltage
codex.quest.ie_start.blast.text.0: Another cube, this time blast bricks. Iron and coke in — steel out, slowly, with orange light in the cracks. The preheater speeds it up, the advanced furnace doubles it. Steel is the material of everything you build next.
codex.quest.ie_start.blast.title: Blast Furnace
codex.quest.ie_start.coke_oven.text.0: Twenty-seven coke bricks in a cube, a hammer blow — and the oven breathes. Coal in, coke out, and creosote drips below — the black oil the whole mod stands on. The first real industry in this pack smells exactly like this.
codex.quest.ie_start.coke_oven.title: Coke Oven
codex.quest.ie_start.components.text.0: Iron, steel, electronic — the consumable parts of any machine. Electronic ones need copper wire and redstone, advanced ones gold too.
codex.quest.ie_start.components.title: Components
codex.quest.ie_start.hammer.text.0: A hit on a multiblock — and a pile of bricks becomes a machine. The hammer also makes plates from ingots at the crafting table, rotates blocks and takes apart the surplus. Wire cutters remove wires, the screwdriver configures.
codex.quest.ie_start.hammer.title: Engineer's Hammer
codex.quest.ie_start.manual.text.0: A book of blueprints. Every multiblock is shown in three dimensions, layer by layer. Without it the blast furnace takes two tries; the excavator — never.
codex.quest.ie_start.manual.title: Engineer's Manual
codex.quest.ie_start.scaffold.text.0: Scaffolds, railings, catwalks. The pack's industrial look stands on them — literally.
codex.quest.ie_start.scaffold.title: Scaffolding and Stairs
codex.quest.ie_start.treated.text.0: Planks soaked in creosote don't rot and bear the weight of machines. Pour in a barrel or a tank — and make a lot at once: everyone will ask.
codex.quest.ie_start.treated.title: Treated Wood
codex.quest.ie_start.workbench.text.0: Blueprints are this bench's language: components, cartridges, turret parts, electronics. It also upgrades the drill, buzzsaw, revolver and railgun.
codex.quest.ie_start.workbench.title: Engineer's Workbench
codex.quest.life_furniture.comforts2.tex: The hammock hangs from a rope-and-nail and skips the day. The sleeping bag skips the night without moving your spawn.
Copper shingles and tiles in every oxidation stage, framed glass, girders, ladders, table cloths, postboxes and nixie tubes.
Copycat blocks take the look of any other block.
codex.quest.life_furniture.domum.text.0: The architect's cutter makes brick, tile, timber frame, panels, lights, carpets and doors from any materials.
codex.quest.life_furniture.domum.text.1: Formally a MineColonies library, but its blocks are useful in any build.
codex.quest.life_furniture.domum.title: Domum Ornamentum
The mod adds hundreds of blocks from every dimension: amber bricks, comet wood, eden stone, lava lamps, vases, paintings and records.
The museum and showcases let you display trophies.
codex.quest.life_furniture.et_deco.title: Eternal Tales Decor
codex.quest.life_furniture.furnicraft.te: Furnicraft in this pack is a datapack (ketket_furnitures). Furniture is assembled at the carpenter's bench from wood, iron, wool and lanterns.
Recipes are fully described inside the datapack and visible in JEI.
codex.quest.life_furniture.handcrafted.t: Tables, chairs, benches, cupboards, nightstands and shelves for every wood, plus crockery, cushions, sheets, mob trophies and wall decor.
Trims and corner pieces give tidy wall joints.
codex.quest.life_furniture.macaw.text.0: Seven mods by one author cover what vanilla lacks entirely: roofs at real angles, doors and gates of every kind, windows with shutters, stairs and railings, bridges, lamps and holiday decor.
codex.quest.life_furniture.macaw.text.1: Everything crafts from ordinary materials and fits any style, from rustic to industrial.
codex.quest.life_furniture.macaw.title: The Macaw's Series
codex.quest.life_furniture.refurbished.t: Modern furniture: kitchens with sinks and cabinets, bathrooms, sofas, blinds, ceiling fans, mailboxes, a TV and a working computer.
Many items are functional: the sink draws water, the fridge stores food, the toaster toasts bread.
codex.quest.life_world.compass.text.0: Nature's Compass finds a biome by name, Explorer's Compass finds a structure. Pick from the list and the compass shows direction and distance.
codex.quest.life_world.compass.text.1: In a world with over a hundred biomes and even more structures, that isn't cheating — it's how you avoid losing an evening looking for a village.
codex.quest.life_world.compass.title: Explorer's Compasses
codex.quest.life_world.dh.text.0: Distant Horizons draws terrain far beyond the loaded chunks using simplified models.
codex.quest.life_world.dh.text.1: Data accumulates as you explore and is stored locally; the first pass is always the slowest.
codex.quest.life_world.dh.title: Distant Horizons
Lootr makes structure chests personal: every player opens their own loot. A stronghold looted by a neighbour an hour ago is still full for you.
codex.quest.life_world.lootr_world.title: Personal Loot
codex.quest.life_world.mobs.text.0: Besides vanilla, the world holds hundreds of Eternal Tales creatures, Alex's Mobs beasts, Cataclysm and Mowzie's bosses, Mutant Monsters, MineColonies raiders, and the residents of Aether and the Twilight Forest.
codex.quest.life_world.mobs.text.1: LetMeDespawn clears the surplus so the server can breathe.
codex.quest.life_world.mobs.title: The Pack's Mobs
codex.quest.life_world.structures.text.0: Besides vanilla, the world generates Create builds (Structures Arise and Rustic Structures), Eternal Tales villages and towers, Cataclysm dungeons, waystones and Terralith structures.
codex.quest.life_world.structures.title: Structures
codex.quest.life_world.terralith.text.0: Terralith changes the world's shape: real mountain ranges, canyons, cave systems, oases and volcanoes.
codex.quest.life_world.terralith.text.1: Vanilla structures and ore generation remain.
codex.quest.life_world.terralith.title: Terralith
codex.quest.life_world.waystones2.text.0: Stones found in the world activate for free. Your own go anywhere. A sharestone serves the whole group; a portstone links two points directly.
codex.quest.life_world.waystones2.text.1: Portal scrolls and warp dust let you travel without a stone.
codex.quest.life_world.waystones2.title: Waystone Network
codex.quest.life_world.xaero.text.0: Minimap and full map keep themselves. Waypoints, zones, entity tracking and party members are configured in the map menu.
codex.quest.life_world.xaero.text.1: Better Party syncs group markers to both maps.
codex.quest.life_world.xaero.title: Xaero's Maps
codex.quest.magic_agriculture.altar.text: The altar and eight pedestals around it: four on the axes three blocks out, four on the diagonals at two.
This is where seeds are made: the prosperity base in the center, four pieces of the resource and four essences of its tier around it.
codex.quest.magic_agriculture.augments.t: An unattuned augment becomes any of fifty: night vision, step assist, five-by-five mining, health, strength, speed.
They're installed at the tinkering table. One slot, or two on awakened supremium. The flight augment costs four nether stars and grants creative flight.
The awakening altar, four pedestals and four essence vessels. The vessels take elemental essences — air, earth, water, fire — forty of each per item.
Awakened supremium is the mod's ceiling: thirty-six protection, plus twenty-five damage and two augment slots.
codex.quest.magic_agriculture.crystal.te: Four prosperity shards, four inferium and a diamond. The crystal raises essence tiers: four inferium around it make prudentium, four prudentium make tertium, and so on.
A thousand uses. Later comes the master crystal with no limit.
codex.quest.magic_agriculture.farmland.t: Essence farmland gives a ten percent chance of a second seed on harvest, and twenty if the farmland tier matches the crop's.
A growth accelerator nudges the plant above it every ten seconds. The inferium one reaches nine blocks up, the supremium forty-five.
codex.quest.magic_agriculture.first_seed: Iron is tier three, and a sensible place to start: iron seeds pay for themselves in a couple of harvests.
Harvested essence becomes ingots at the crafting table. Then copper, gold, redstone and everything else you're tired of mining.
codex.quest.magic_agriculture.inferium.t: The first essence. Mined from inferium ore and dropped by any mob at one in five — so the first stock gathers itself.
Prosperity shards from the neighbouring ore are the second base material.
codex.quest.magic_agriculture.insanium.t: The sixth tier from the addon. Insanium crops grow only over special cruxes and yield what can't be grown at all: nether stars, dragon eggs, Gaia Spirits.
Three star shards make one whole star. A star farm is a different economy entirely.
codex.quest.magic_agriculture.machines.t: The harvester reaps for you, the seed reprocessor returns two essences per seed, the essence furnace smelts without coal.
Tier upgrades speed machines enormously: the supremium one makes an operation forty times faster than base.
codex.quest.magic_agriculture.souls.text: The soulium dagger collects souls from mobs you kill, the jar stores them, the extractor pulls them from drops.
Souls feed the mob crops: zombie, creeper, blaze, enderman and even wither skeleton grow in a field like carrots.
Tier five. Supremium tools **never break** — infinite durability, speed twenty-five and plus twenty damage.
The armor gives twenty-nine protection against netherite's twenty. From here on your gear needn't change.
codex.quest.magic_ars.apparatus.text.0: Four arcane pedestals around the apparatus make the bench everything complicated is built on: staves, charms, upgraded books, familiar tokens.
codex.quest.magic_ars.apparatus.text.1: An arcane core beneath it speeds up the work.
codex.quest.magic_ars.apparatus.title: Enchanting Apparatus
codex.quest.magic_ars.archmage.text.0: Ten spell slots, full glyph access and a mana pool that lasts a boss fight.
codex.quest.magic_ars.archmage.text.1: With mage armor it turns Ars Nouveau into a combat branch of its own rather than a box of utilities.
codex.quest.magic_ars.archmage.title: Archmage Spell Book
codex.quest.magic_ars.book.text.0: The novice book holds two spells, the mage's more, the archmage's all of them.
codex.quest.magic_ars.book.text.1: The Scribe's Table writes glyphs onto parchment, and parchment into the book. The form always comes first: projectile, touch, self, burst.
codex.quest.magic_ars.book.title: Spell Book
codex.quest.magic_ars.familiars.text.0: The Starbuncle hauls items between chests, the Whirlisprig tends crops, the Drygmy collects drops from penned mobs without killing them.
codex.quest.magic_ars.familiars.text.1: That's Ars Nouveau's automation: no pipes, just critters.
codex.quest.magic_ars.familiars.title: Helpers
codex.quest.magic_ars.gems.text.0: The Imbuement Chamber turns ordinary items magical: source gems, cloth, magebloom seeds.
codex.quest.magic_ars.gems.text.1: The gem is the mod's currency: everything from jars to altars is made of it.
codex.quest.magic_ars.gems.title: Source Gems
codex.quest.magic_ars.glyphs.text.0: Each glyph is a word in a sentence. Harm, break, ignite, haste, levitate; augments multiply effect and range.
codex.quest.magic_ars.glyphs.text.1: A spell's cost grows with its length, and the novice book doesn't reach far — which is where the fun starts.
codex.quest.magic_ars.glyphs.title: Glyphs
codex.quest.magic_ars.notebook.text.0: The mod's starting book: it explains glyphs, rituals, familiars and everything else. Without it you're guessing.
codex.quest.magic_ars.notebook.text.1: Sourceberries grow nearby — the local sugar cane, needed in nearly every recipe.
codex.quest.magic_ars.notebook.title: Worn Notebook
codex.quest.magic_ars.rituals.text.0: A brazier and a ritual tablet. Rituals change weather, grow forests, move you between points, find ore and open portals.
codex.quest.magic_ars.rituals.text.1: The portal is the most useful: two points, one step between them.
codex.quest.magic_ars.rituals.title: Rituals
codex.quest.magic_ars.source.text.0: The Source Jar stores energy, the relay carries it through the air between jars, the splitter divides the flow.
codex.quest.magic_ars.source.text.1: Source is produced by Sourcelinks: the volcanic one eats lava, the agronomic crops, the alchemical potions, the mycelial mushrooms.
codex.quest.magic_ars.source.title: Source and Relays
codex.quest.magic_botania.apothecary.tex: Cobblestone and a petal. Fill the bowl with water, throw in a set of petals, then any seeds on top: wheat, pumpkin, melon.
An empty right-click takes the last petal back. For twenty seconds after a craft the bowl remembers the recipe and pulls the same set from your inventory — a huge time saver in bulk.
codex.quest.magic_botania.daisy.text.0: Four white petals in the bowl. The daisy stares at an adjacent block for seven seconds and transforms it: log to livingwood, stone to livingrock, water to snow, ice to packed ice.
codex.quest.magic_botania.daisy.text.1: Livingwood and livingrock are the materials for everything that follows, so the daisy gets a log conveyor and is forgotten for a long while.
codex.quest.magic_botania.daisy.title: Pure Daisy
codex.quest.magic_botania.endoflame.text: The Endoflame: two brown petals, a red and a light grey. Eats coal and gives about thirty mana per second. Slow, but forever.
Hydroangeas drink water but crumble after three days. The Thermalily eats lava and needs runes — that's still ahead.
codex.quest.magic_botania.flowers.text.0: Sixteen colours that shimmer and sparkle in the grass. A broken flower gives petals, a tall one gives twice as many.
codex.quest.magic_botania.flowers.text.1: Floral fertilizer from bone meal and dye seeds a meadow around itself — that settles the petal supply for good.
codex.quest.magic_botania.flowers.title: Mystical Flowers
codex.quest.magic_botania.lexicon.text.0: A sapling and a book. After that: shift and right-click any block of the mod, and the Lexica opens the article on exactly that.
codex.quest.magic_botania.lexicon.text.1: Italic entries are the basics. After the elven gateway the book gains two more sections you'd best not think about yet.
codex.quest.magic_botania.lexicon.title: Lexica Botania
codex.quest.magic_botania.manasteel.text: Throw an iron ingot into a full pool — three thousand mana and it becomes manasteel. An ender pearl at six thousand becomes a mana pearl, a diamond at ten a mana diamond.
Manasteel repairs itself as long as there's mana in your inventory. It's the mod's first material and the start of everything else.
codex.quest.magic_botania.pool.text.0: Five livingrock. A full pool holds a million mana — a unit you'll get used to.
codex.quest.magic_botania.pool.text.1: The diluted pool from slabs holds only ten thousand: for small needs and first experiments.
codex.quest.magic_botania.pool.title: Mana Pool
codex.quest.magic_botania.potato.text.0: One thousand three hundred thirty-seven mana for a potato that does nothing and is happy when petted. All of Botania is like this.
codex.quest.magic_botania.potato.title: Tiny Potato
codex.quest.magic_botania.spark.text.0: A spark goes over a pool, a second over a consumer, and mana flows between them on its own. That's Botania's wiring.
codex.quest.magic_botania.spark.text.1: Augments change behaviour: dispersive charges items in your pockets, dominant pulls mana from neighbouring pools, recessive gives its own away.
codex.quest.magic_botania.spark.title: Sparks
Six livingwood logs, a copper ingot and a petal. It gathers mana from the bound flower and shoots it into a pool — in a straight line, so keep the firing lane clear.
Mana in flight decays over distance: the wand shows where the losses begin.
codex.quest.magic_botania.spreader.title: Mana Spreader
codex.quest.magic_botania.tablet.text.0: The tablet holds half a million mana and feeds every mana item in your inventory. The mana ring does the same from an accessory slot.
codex.quest.magic_botania.tablet.text.1: Without portable mana, Botania's tools are just pretty hardware.
codex.quest.magic_botania.tablet.title: Mana in Your Pocket
codex.quest.magic_botania.wand.text.0: The mod's main tool. Shift-click the air to switch modes: binding and block rotation.
codex.quest.magic_botania.wand.text.1: In binding mode, shift-click a flower then a pool and the flower knows where to send mana. With the wand in hand you see pool levels and firing lines.
codex.quest.magic_botania.wand.title: Wand of the Forest
codex.quest.magic_botania_end.corporea.t: A corporea spark sits over a chest and sees what's inside. The master spark ties it all into a network, and the Corporea Index takes requests by voice — literally: type '10 apples' in chat and they fly to you.
It's Botania's warehouse: no pipes, no cables, plenty of character.
codex.quest.magic_botania_end.elven_gear: Elementium armor summons avenging pixies: the more pieces, the more often. The elementium axe takes heads, the pickaxe voids junk, the shovel clears a column of sand.
The elven spreader shoots further and faster than the plain one.
codex.quest.magic_botania_end.gaia1.text: An active beacon, four Gaia pylons at the corners and an arena twelve blocks in radius with no ceiling. Shift-click the beacon with a terrasteel ingot.
The Guardian has three hundred twenty health, ten waves of minions and a damage cap of thirty-two per hit — he can't be burst down.
The reward is Gaia Spirits: six, or eight if you fight alone.
codex.quest.magic_botania_end.gaia2.text: Four Gaia Spirits and terrasteel make a Gaia Spirit Ingot. Sacrifice it at the beacon and a hardened Guardian steps out: faster, meaner, tougher.
He drops Ancient Wills for terrasteel tools, lotuses, overgrowth seeds — and the Dice of Fate.
codex.quest.magic_botania_end.portal.tex: A core of livingwood logs and terrasteel nuggets, surrounded by eight livingwood and three glimmering. Nearby you need at least two mana pools with natura pylons on top.
Opening costs two hundred thousand mana. The portal doesn't admit you: you throw items in and the elves send theirs back.
codex.quest.magic_botania_end.rank_ss.te: The Terra Shatterer ranks up by mana absorbed: a billion mana is rank SS and an area you'd be afraid to switch on near your house.
The advancement is called 'A Tale of Six Trillion Years and a Night'.
codex.quest.magic_botania_end.relics.tex: The Dice of Fate hand out one relic per roll until all six are collected. Odin's Ring adds ten hearts, Thor's widens the Terra Shatterer, Loki's places blocks by template.
Relics are bound to their owner by name: someone else's is useless. Protect them with Keep Ivy so a death doesn't cost you one.
codex.quest.magic_botania_end.trade.text: Two manasteel become elementium. A mana pearl becomes pixie dust. A mana diamond becomes dragonstone. Livingwood becomes dreamwood.
Throw the Lexica in: it comes back with the elven chapters.
codex.quest.magic_botania_runes.altar.te: Three livingrock and a mana pearl. Components go on the altar, a spreader is aimed at it, you wait — then throw a chunk of livingrock to take the rune.
codex.quest.magic_botania_runes.belt.tex: Speed and a higher jump, paid for with mana from your inventory. Almost everyone makes it the moment they reach terrasteel.
The brewery makes brews — the local potions, poured into vials and flasks. Twenty-one kinds.
codex.quest.magic_botania_runes.elements: Water, earth, fire, air — five thousand two hundred mana each. This is the foundation: no thermalily, no rods, no terrasteel plate without them.
codex.quest.magic_botania_runes.flowers2: Runes open the functional flowers. Agricarnation speeds crops, the Hopperhock gathers drops into chests, the Orechid turns stone into ore, the Gourmaryllis eats your food and pays in mana.
Functional flowers take mana only from a pool, never from a spreader — a common mistake.
codex.quest.magic_botania_runes.halo.tex: A portable crafting table for three recipes, spinning around your hand. A trifle that saves hours.
codex.quest.magic_botania_runes.mana_run: Five manasteel and a mana pearl, eight thousand mana. The last component of the terrestrial plate.
codex.quest.magic_botania_runes.terra_ge: The Terra Blade fires a beam at full health. The Terra Shatterer stores mana and climbs ranks from D to SS — the rank sets how much it breaks in one swing.
Terrasteel armor is close to netherite and repairs with mana too.
codex.quest.magic_botania_runes.terra_pl: Three lapis blocks, a manasteel block and five runes. The plate goes on a checkerboard floor of lapis and livingrock.
codex.quest.magic_botania_runes.terraste: Manasteel, a mana pearl and a mana diamond go on the plate, then half a million mana pours in — half a full pool.
Take an item off halfway and all the mana is lost. Several sparks speed this up enormously.
codex.quest.magic_irons.arcane.text.0: Arcane debris is found in the Nether, smelted into ingots and worked at the Arcane Anvil.
codex.quest.magic_irons.arcane.text.1: It makes staves, runes and gear that strengthens a particular school.
codex.quest.magic_irons.arcane.title: Arcane Metal
codex.quest.magic_irons.inscription.text: It moves a scroll into a spell book. The book holds as many spells as its tier allows, from flimsy journal to enchanted tome.
codex.quest.magic_irons.legendary.text.0: Top-tier spells are written with special ink. Getting it is harder than everything before it combined.
codex.quest.magic_irons.legendary.text.1: After that a mage stops depending on finds and writes what they want.
codex.quest.magic_irons.legendary.title: Legendary Ink
codex.quest.magic_irons.robes.text.0: Pyromancer, cryomancer, electromancer, shadowwalker, priest, archevoker — each school has a set that raises its spell power and mana pool.
codex.quest.magic_irons.robes.text.1: The armor drops from mages of the matching type, and hunting them is a pastime of its own.
codex.quest.magic_irons.robes.title: Mage Robes
codex.quest.magic_irons.runes.text.0: Runes of fire, ice, lightning, blood, holy, ender, nature and evocation. Each boosts its school when set into gear at the anvil.
codex.quest.magic_irons.runes.text.1: A blank runestone is the blank for any of them.
codex.quest.magic_irons.runes.title: School Runes
codex.quest.magic_irons.scroll.text.0: Scrolls drop from mages, lie in dungeons and are sold by wandering traders. One scroll is one spell, and it can be cast straight from your hand.
