codex.quest.magic_irons.scroll.text.1: The ruined book comes from the same places: every mage starts with one.
codex.quest.magic_irons.scroll.title: First Scroll
codex.quest.magic_irons.staff.text.0: The Blood Staff is one of the mod's strongest weapons: it spends health instead of mana and hits accordingly.
codex.quest.magic_irons.staff.text.1: There are peaceful staves too, but this one is memorable.
codex.quest.magic_irons.staff.title: Staff
codex.quest.magic_irons.upgrade.text.0: Orbs attach permanent bonuses to armor: school power, mana regeneration, shorter cooldowns.
codex.quest.magic_irons.upgrade.text.1: An empty orb is filled toward a chosen school — that's how a set is tuned to your style.
codex.quest.magic_irons.upgrade.title: Upgrade Orbs
codex.quest.mc_build.cutter.reward.0: A huge palette of building materials
codex.quest.mc_build.cutter.text.0: Brick, tile, timber frame, panels, lights, doors, carpets — from any materials in hundreds of combinations. All colony styles stand on this.
codex.quest.mc_build.cutter.title: Architect's Cutter
codex.quest.mc_build.decoration.text.0: Decor the builder raises alongside buildings.
codex.quest.mc_build.decoration.title: Decoration Controller
codex.quest.mc_build.multipiston.text.0: Dozens of blocks at once over a set distance. Drawbridges, gates, roofs.
codex.quest.mc_build.multipiston.title: Multi-Piston
codex.quest.mc_build.scepter.text.0: The scepter selects, the shape tool builds spheres and domes, the caliper measures.
codex.quest.mc_build.scepter.title: Structurize Tools
codex.quest.mc_build.substitution.text.0: Air, solid, fluid, tag — the schematic adapts to the terrain itself.
codex.quest.mc_build.substitution.title: Substitution Blocks
codex.quest.mc_build.timberframe.text.0: Wood and infill. The medieval look is recognized by it.
codex.quest.mc_build.timberframe.title: Timber Frame
codex.quest.mc_found.builder.text.0: The first and the main one. Builds everything, including his own upgrade. The resource scroll shows from your inventory what he lacks right now.
codex.quest.mc_found.builder.title: Builder
codex.quest.mc_found.buildtool.text.0: A ghost of a building goes on the ground, rotates, confirms — and the builder gets to work. Goggles show where future walls go.
codex.quest.mc_found.buildtool.title: Build Tool
codex.quest.mc_found.citizen.text.0: A house is room for citizens. The tavern is the first shelter and bait for newcomers.
codex.quest.mc_found.citizen.title: Citizen Housing
codex.quest.mc_found.food.text.0: A hungry citizen doesn't work. The cook makes from what the farmer, shepherd and fisher bring; the kitchen and baker widen the menu to dozens of dishes.
codex.quest.mc_found.food.title: Food
codex.quest.mc_found.hospital.text.0: The hospital heals. The graveyard buries — and with a totem of undying, brings back.
codex.quest.mc_found.hospital.title: Hospital and Graveyard
codex.quest.mc_found.mystical.text.0: Happiness. Happy citizens work faster and fall sick less.
codex.quest.mc_found.mystical.title: Mystical Site
codex.quest.mc_found.postbox.text.0: Order from the warehouse without chasing the courier.
codex.quest.mc_found.postbox.title: Postbox
codex.quest.mc_found.supply.text.0: Chest on water, camp on land. Unfolds into a starting pad with town hall, builder and stock. Placed once — pick a spot you'd live a hundred hours at.
codex.quest.mc_found.supply.title: Supply Chest
codex.quest.mc_found.townhall.text.0: The town hall declares borders and opens the citizen list, statistics, permissions. Its level is the population cap.
codex.quest.mc_found.townhall.title: Town Hall
codex.quest.mc_found.warehouse.text.0: The warehouse stores, racks are shelves, the courier carries. Without a courier the colony stands still: materials lie, workers wait, you wonder.
codex.quest.mc_found.warehouse.title: Warehouse and Courier
codex.quest.mc_military.banner.text.0: All guards — to one point. When the wall is breached.
codex.quest.mc_military.banner.title: Rally Banner
codex.quest.mc_military.barracks.text.0: Up to four towers in one building. A garrison.
codex.quest.mc_military.barracks.title: Barracks
Tower — guard. Archer or knight, gear from the warehouse.
codex.quest.mc_military.guardtower.title: Guard Tower
codex.quest.mc_military.raid.text.0: The chief falls — and so does his sword. Raids are announced in chat beforehand; the night after is long.
codex.quest.mc_military.raid.title: Raid Repelled
codex.quest.mc_military.training.text.0: Academy for knights, archery for archers.
codex.quest.mc_military.training.title: Training
codex.quest.mc_military.walls.text.0: Gates open for your own. The gatehouse holds a wall section.
codex.quest.mc_military.walls.title: Walls and Gates
codex.quest.mc_production.animals.text.0: Shepherd, cowboy, swineherd, chicken herder, rabbits, bees, stable.
codex.quest.mc_production.animals.title: Livestock
codex.quest.mc_production.blacksmith.tex: Blacksmith — tools and armor; mechanic — mechanisms, including other mods'. Fletcher, glassblower, dyer cover the rest.
codex.quest.mc_production.concrete.title: Other Production
codex.quest.mc_production.fisherman.text: Fish and what lies on the bottom.
codex.quest.mc_production.lumberjack.tex: Fells and replants. Knows every wood in the pack.
codex.quest.mc_production.miner.text.0: Digs a mine in levels. The stonemason cuts stone, the crusher grinds cobble to gravel and sand, the sifter shakes rarities from the soil.
codex.quest.mc_production.miner.title: Miner
codex.quest.mc_production.nether.text.0: Goes on expeditions and brings quartz, gold, trophies. Or doesn't.
codex.quest.mc_production.nether.title: Nether Worker
codex.quest.mc_production.plants.text.0: Plantation — cane, bamboo, cactus. Florist — flowers. Composter — fertilizer.
codex.quest.mc_production.plants.title: Horticulture
codex.quest.mc_production.quarry.text.0: A pit to bedrock and everything that was in it.
codex.quest.mc_production.quarry.title: Quarry
codex.quest.mc_production.sawmill.text.0: Planks, doors, stairs, furniture — on the builder's orders.
codex.quest.mc_production.sawmill.title: Sawmill
Ore to ingots; stone and sand in the stone one. Level is furnace count.
codex.quest.mc_production.smeltery.title: Smelteries
codex.quest.mc_research.enchanter.text.0: Gathers experience from workers, makes books and scrolls: teleport, buff, guard summon.
codex.quest.mc_research.enchanter.title: Enchanter
codex.quest.mc_research.library.title: Library
codex.quest.mc_research.quests.text.0: Citizens ask. The log remembers. Rewards — experience, rarities, tokens.
codex.quest.mc_research.quests.title: Colony Quests
codex.quest.mc_research.school.text.0: Children grow up smarter than their parents.
codex.quest.mc_research.school.title: School
codex.quest.mc_research.tome.text.0: Drops from raiders. Needed by research.
codex.quest.mc_research.tome.title: Ancient Tome
The research tree: civilization, technology, war, supply. Fifth building levels open only here.
codex.quest.mc_research.university.title: University
codex.quest.mek_gear.atomic_disassembler: Digs everything, cuts everything, takes a vein whole. The first tool after which a pickaxe looks like a stick.
codex.quest.mek_gear.laser.text.0: Cuts at range. The amplifier stores, the tractor beam gathers drops.
codex.quest.mek_gear.laser.title: Lasers
codex.quest.mek_gear.mekasuit.text.0: Atomic alloy, ultimate circuits, diamonds — four pieces. Empty for now.
codex.quest.mek_gear.mekasuit.title: MekaSuit Set
codex.quest.mek_gear.mekatool.text.0: A whole vein, fortune or silk, till, shear, teleport, strike. The last tool you'll make.
codex.quest.mek_gear.mekatool.title: Meka-Tool
codex.quest.mek_gear.modification.text.0: Modules go in and out. Levels stack.
codex.quest.mek_gear.modification.title: Modification Station
codex.quest.mek_gear.modules_core.text.0: Capacity, solar recharge, charge distribution. Without them the suit is empty in a minute. Electrolytic breathing — infinite air underwater.
codex.quest.mek_gear.modules_core.title: Core Modules
codex.quest.mek_gear.modules_move.text.0: The gravitational modulator — creative flight in survival. Hydraulics — jump, boosting — run, plus lava and ice underfoot.
codex.quest.mek_gear.modules_move.title: Movement
codex.quest.mek_gear.modules_util.text.0: Night vision, magnet, stabilization, laser and radiation shielding, Geiger and feeding — in helmet and chest.
codex.quest.mek_gear.modules_util.title: Utility
codex.quest.mek_gear.robit.text.0: Picks up, smelts, crafts, follows. The charge pad is home.
codex.quest.mek_gear.robit.title: Robit
codex.quest.mek_gear.scuba.text.0: Mask and tank — water. Hydrogen jetpack — sky; in this pack it's worn in an accessory slot, chestplate stays on. Free runners cushion falls and run up slopes.
codex.quest.mek_gear.scuba.title: Breathing and Flight
codex.quest.mek_gear.security.title: Security
codex.quest.mek_nuclear.fuel.text.0: Cake, centrifuge, solar neutron activator — hexafluoride, then fissile fuel. The assembly goes into the reactor and quietly burns.
codex.quest.mek_nuclear.fuel.title: Fuel Assemblies
codex.quest.mek_nuclear.fusion.text.0: Deuterium and tritium from heavy water, a hohlraum with fuel, a laser that lights a star. Then it burns on its own, no waste and no fear.
codex.quest.mek_nuclear.fusion.title: Fusion Reactor
codex.quest.mek_nuclear.hazmat.text.0: The suit lowers the dose, the Geiger counter shows background, the dosimeter how much you've taken. Don't approach a reactor without all three.
codex.quest.mek_nuclear.hazmat.title: Hazmat Suit
codex.quest.mek_nuclear.reactor.text.0: Casing, ports, assemblies, rods, coolant. You set the burn rate — and you answer if temperature crosses the limit. Wire the logic adapter to an emergency stop before you load the first assembly. That's not advice. It's the only rule.
codex.quest.mek_nuclear.reactor.title: Fission Reactor
codex.quest.mek_nuclear.sps.reward.0: The top of Mekanism's tech tree
codex.quest.mek_nuclear.sps.text.0: Polonium into antimatter at a monstrous energy cost. Antimatter to the nucleosynthesizer, which makes what doesn't exist.
codex.quest.mek_nuclear.sps.title: Supercritical Phase Shifter
codex.quest.mek_nuclear.uranium.text.0: Deep and rare. Ingot to yellowcake, yellowcake to fuel. Unprotected it warms your hands in the worst sense.
codex.quest.mek_nuclear.uranium.title: Uranium
codex.quest.mek_nuclear.waste.text.0: The barrel slowly decays waste; a full barrel is a release. Waste also processes into polonium and plutonium, and that's where it gets interesting.
codex.quest.mek_nuclear.waste.title: Waste
codex.quest.mek_ore.crusher_mek.text.0: The crusher — ingots back to dust; the combiner — dust and stone into ore. The cycle is closed.
codex.quest.mek_ore.crusher_mek.title: Crusher and Combiner
codex.quest.mek_ore.dissolution.text.0: Dissolve in acid, wash, crystallize, crush, enrich. Four new machines and a lot of energy. Five ingots from one ore — the mod's ceiling, and it pays back in an evening.
codex.quest.mek_ore.dissolution.title: Dissolution and Crystallization (×5)
codex.quest.mek_ore.enrichment.text.0: Ore into two crushed pieces, pieces into two ingots. Also — enriched substances for the infuser.
codex.quest.mek_ore.enrichment.title: Enrichment Chamber (×2)
codex.quest.mek_ore.evaporation.text.0: A tower in the sun boils water to brine, brine to salt. The source of chlorine, sulfuric acid and heavy water. Taller and hotter is faster.
codex.quest.mek_ore.evaporation.title: Thermal Evaporation Plant
codex.quest.mek_ore.factory.text.0: One machine, several lanes: three, five, seven, nine. The tier installer upgrades a standing factory without taking it apart.
codex.quest.mek_ore.factory.title: Factories
codex.quest.mek_ore.injection.text.0: Ore and hydrogen chloride — four shards. Chlorine from brine, hydrogen from water, together in the chemical infuser. This is a plant now.
codex.quest.mek_ore.injection.title: Chemical Injection (×4)
codex.quest.mek_ore.miner.text.0: Radius, heights, filter — and it digs only what you named, touching nothing else. With the stone generator it leaves solid rock behind; with silk touch it brings blocks whole.
codex.quest.mek_ore.miner.title: Digital Miner
codex.quest.mek_ore.purification.text.0: Ore and oxygen — three pieces. Oxygen comes from the separator splitting water; keep the hydrogen — the jetpack will want it.
codex.quest.mek_ore.purification.title: Purification Chamber (×3)
codex.quest.mek_ore.sawmill.text.0: The sawmill takes items apart, the smelter melts cheaply, the formulaic assemblicator crafts by formula.
codex.quest.mek_ore.sawmill.title: Sawmill and More
codex.quest.mek_ore.upgrades.text.0: Speed, energy efficiency, gas filter, muffling, chunk anchor. Speed eats energy — balance it.
codex.quest.mek_ore.upgrades.title: Machine Upgrades
codex.quest.mek_power.bio.text.0: Plants through the crusher — biofuel. The farm feeds the power plant.
codex.quest.mek_power.bio.title: Bio Generator
codex.quest.mek_power.boiler.text.0: Water to steam from heaters or a reactor. Steam to the turbine.
codex.quest.mek_power.boiler.title: Thermal Boiler
codex.quest.mek_power.gas_gen.text.0: Ethylene is the mod's densest gas. Biofuel, water and substrate in the reaction chamber make it; the generator burns it. This pair feeds a base up to the reactor.
codex.quest.mek_power.gas_gen.title: Gas-Burning Generator
codex.quest.mek_power.heat_gen.text.0: Coal or lava. Weak, but from minute one.
codex.quest.mek_power.heat_gen.title: Heat Generator
codex.quest.mek_power.induction.text.0: Cells set capacity, providers set speed. Upper tiers store numbers that don't fit in a head.
codex.quest.mek_power.induction.title: Induction Matrix
codex.quest.mek_power.solar.text.0: Regular — a little; advanced three-by-three — noticeably.
codex.quest.mek_power.solar.title: Solar Panels
codex.quest.mek_power.turbine.text.0: A rotor in a tower, blades on the rotor, condensers on top. Built right, it puts out millions per tick — and sounds real.
codex.quest.mek_power.turbine.title: Steam Turbine
codex.quest.mek_power.wind.text.0: Higher is stronger. On a Terralith peak — the best passive of the early game.
codex.quest.mek_power.wind.title: Wind Generator
Energy, fluid, gas, items — between two points with no pipe. Reactor at the world's edge, turbine at home.
codex.quest.mek_qio.entangloporter.title: Quantum Entangloporter
codex.quest.mek_qio.qio_array.text.0: Base, hyper-dense, time-dilating, supermassive. The names are honest.
codex.quest.mek_qio.qio_array.title: QIO Drive Array
codex.quest.mek_qio.qio_dash.text.0: A window into storage without a single cable. Portable — in your pocket.
codex.quest.mek_qio.qio_dash.title: QIO Dashboard
codex.quest.mek_qio.qio_io.text.0: Importer puts in, exporter takes out by filter, adapter gives a signal.
codex.quest.mek_qio.qio_io.title: Import and Export
codex.quest.mek_qio.stabilizer.text.0: Holds chunks. An ultimate circuit — and your base never sleeps.
codex.quest.mek_qio.stabilizer.title: Dimensional Stabilizer
codex.quest.mek_qio.teleport_core.text.0: The shared part of everything that breaks distance.
codex.quest.mek_qio.teleport_core.title: Teleportation Core
codex.quest.mek_qio.teleporter.text.0: Two teleporters on one frequency — and between them there's no path, only a step. Across dimensions too. The portable one carries you to any fixed one.
codex.quest.mek_qio.teleporter.title: Teleporter
codex.quest.mek_start.alloys.text.0: Infused, reinforced, atomic. Each a tier higher and chemistry harder.
codex.quest.mek_start.alloys.title: Alloys
codex.quest.mek_start.box.text.0: A machine into a box — with contents and settings. Moving in a minute.
codex.quest.mek_start.box.title: Cardboard Box
codex.quest.mek_start.cables.text.0: Cable for energy, pipe for fluid, pressurized tube for gas, transporter for items, conductor for heat. Five kinds, five tiers, one logic.
codex.quest.mek_start.cables.title: Transmission
codex.quest.mek_start.casing.text.0: Steel, osmium, glass. The shared part of every machine in the mod — from enrichment chamber to fusion reactor.
codex.quest.mek_start.casing.title: Steel Casing
codex.quest.mek_start.circuit.text.0: Basic from osmium, advanced from infused alloy, elite from reinforced, ultimate from atomic. The circuit tier is the ceiling of what you can build.
codex.quest.mek_start.circuit.title: Control Circuits
Sides, rotation, draining, pickup. The card copies one machine's settings to another.
codex.quest.mek_start.configurator.title: Configurator
codex.quest.mek_start.energy.text.0: The cube stores and converts between grids. The induction matrix is a battery the size of a house.
codex.quest.mek_start.energy.title: Energy Storage
codex.quest.mek_start.infuser.text.0: The first machine, and already alchemy: an item is infused with a substance — carbon, redstone, diamond, tin — and becomes another item. Steel, alloys, reinforced materials — all from here.
codex.quest.mek_start.infuser.title: Metallurgic Infuser
codex.quest.mek_start.osmium.text.0: A bluish metal that lies everywhere and is needed by everything. Casings, cables, first parts. Beside it — tin, lead, fluorite and uranium; leave the uranium alone for now.
codex.quest.mek_start.osmium.title: Osmium
codex.quest.mek_start.sorter.text.0: By item, by tag, by color. Diversion and restrictive transporters steer the flow.
codex.quest.mek_start.sorter.title: Logistical Sorting
codex.quest.mek_start.steel.text.0: Iron plus enriched carbon — a blank; blank in the furnace — an ingot. Its own steel, different from IE's, and in this pack they'll have to coexist.
codex.quest.mek_start.steel.title: Steel
codex.quest.missiles.computer.text.0: The computer takes a target from the targeting interface or radar and steers the missile with the fins.
codex.quest.missiles.computer.title: Guidance Computer
codex.quest.missiles.fins.text.0: Actuator fins turn the missile in flight on commands from the guidance computer.
codex.quest.missiles.fins.title: Fins
codex.quest.missiles.fuze_prox.text.0: Detonates the warhead near an air target — the basis of anti-air missiles.
codex.quest.missiles.fuze_prox.title: Proximity Fuze
codex.quest.missiles.motor_rocket.text.0: The motor gives thrust to a physics object. More motors, more speed and less burn time.
codex.quest.missiles.motor_rocket.title: Rocket Motor
The mount holds the missile until launch and releases on a signal. With a radar and fire controller it's a full SAM system.
codex.quest.missiles.mount_missile.title: Launcher
codex.quest.more_et_side.arky.text.0: A pretty raccoon and his suit.
codex.quest.more_et_side.arky.title: Arky
codex.quest.more_et_side.blue_moon.title: Blue Moon
codex.quest.more_et_side.bomb.text.0: Eternal Tales' atomic bomb. Away from the base. Further.
codex.quest.more_et_side.bomb.title: Royal Boom
codex.quest.more_et_side.chests.text.0: Digging, fishing, growing, sorcery — every skill leaves a chest.
codex.quest.more_et_side.chests.title: Four Chests
codex.quest.more_et_side.clown.title: Circus
codex.quest.more_et_side.crabs.title: Crabsapocalypse
codex.quest.more_et_side.darwin.text.0: Die all three stupid ways. The book doesn't judge.
codex.quest.more_et_side.darwin.title: Darwin Award
codex.quest.more_et_side.gravicycle.text: Build it, push it to the limit, don't crash.
codex.quest.more_et_side.lamps.title: Light of the Night
codex.quest.more_et_side.music.title: Collector
codex.quest.more_et_side.raccoons.text.0: Every kind. The cookie reward — from them too.
codex.quest.more_et_side.raccoons.title: Raccoons
codex.quest.more_et_side.tarkos.title: Tarkos
codex.quest.more_explore.amberian.text.0: The capital of the Kingdom of Amber.
codex.quest.more_explore.amberian.title: Amberian City
codex.quest.more_explore.amethyst.text.0: Purple stone and crystals growing from the walls.
codex.quest.more_explore.amethyst.title: Amethyst Canyon
codex.quest.more_explore.atlas_done.text: Fifteen places you've stood in. Xaero's map remembers each.
codex.quest.more_explore.endbop.text.0: Mirage islands in the middle of a warm ocean.
codex.quest.more_explore.endbop.title: Mirage Isles
codex.quest.more_explore.geob.text.0: Eternal Tales' radioactive biome in the overworld. Don't linger.
codex.quest.more_explore.geob.title: Geobstractsite
codex.quest.more_explore.glacial.title: Glacial Chasm
codex.quest.more_explore.hotsprings.text: A night biome glowing with its own light.
codex.quest.more_explore.lavender.text.0: Terralith's lavender fields — valley and forest side by side. Find both.
codex.quest.more_explore.lavender.title: Lavender Valley
codex.quest.more_explore.mucun.title: Mucunfectio
codex.quest.more_explore.mystic.text.0: Terralith's green mountains, where emerald sits outside the veins too.
codex.quest.more_explore.mystic.title: Emerald Peaks
codex.quest.more_explore.ominous.text.0: Another Terralith volcano — with a lava lake instead of water.
codex.quest.more_explore.ominous.title: Volcanic Crater
codex.quest.more_explore.redwood.text.0: Fog between the trunks and moss up to your knees.
codex.quest.more_explore.redwood.title: Cloud Forest
codex.quest.more_explore.sakura.text.0: Terralith's pink forest. Build a house here — you'll want to anyway.
codex.quest.more_explore.sakura.title: Sakura Grove
codex.quest.more_explore.skylands.text.0: Islands in the air, before Aether. Spring, autumn — any.
codex.quest.more_explore.skylands.title: Skylands
codex.quest.more_explore.volcano.text.0: A Terralith volcano with a lake inside.
codex.quest.more_explore.volcano.title: Caldera
Striped terracotta slopes in every shade.
codex.quest.more_explore.wasteland.title: Painted Mountains
codex.quest.more_home.bed.text.0: Bed, nightstand, lamp, rug. Handcrafted and Refurbished — your pick.
codex.quest.more_home.bed.title: Bedroom
codex.quest.more_home.garden.text.0: Beds on rich soil, an Eternal Tales gardener's pot, an IE cloche. Three schools of farming in one yard.
codex.quest.more_home.garden.title: Garden
codex.quest.more_home.hall.text.0: Boss trophies on the walls, a Twilight Forest pedestal, an Eternal Tales museum showcase. A home with something to tell.
codex.quest.more_home.hall.title: Hall
codex.quest.more_home.kitchen.task.0: Assemble a kitchen from Refurbished Furniture
codex.quest.more_home.kitchen.text.0: Sink, cabinets, fridge, toaster. All working.
codex.quest.more_home.kitchen.title: Kitchen
codex.quest.more_home.workshop.text.0: The architect's cutter, the Furnicraft carpenter's bench, Create's schematic table. The place a home is made.
codex.quest.more_home.workshop.title: Workshop
codex.quest.more_kitchen.bread.text.0: Bacon, chicken, egg — between two slices. Road food.
codex.quest.more_kitchen.bread.title: Sandwiches
codex.quest.more_kitchen.colony_food.tex: MineColonies adds dozens of dishes: pizza, borscht, kimchi, lembas. The cook makes them himself, but so can you.
codex.quest.more_kitchen.et_food.text.0: Crabsburger, mutatongue chowder, blueberry cookies. Eternal Tales feeds strangely but well.
codex.quest.more_kitchen.et_food.title: Food of Other Worlds
codex.quest.more_kitchen.feast_hall.text: Honey-glazed ham, roast chicken, stuffed pumpkin — three feasts on one table. Call your friends.
codex.quest.more_kitchen.pies.text.0: Apple, chocolate, sweet berry. Whole — onto the table.
codex.quest.more_kitchen.pies.title: Pies
codex.quest.more_kitchen.stew.text.0: Beef stew, chicken soup, fish stew. A pot and patience.
codex.quest.more_kitchen.stew.title: Three Soups
codex.quest.more_munitions.belt.text.0: One hundred twenty-eight cartridges and a container. The autocannon eats fast.
codex.quest.more_munitions.belt.title: Belt
codex.quest.more_munitions.fuzes.text.0: Impact, inertia, timed, proximity, wired. Eight of each — for any case.
codex.quest.more_munitions.fuzes.title: Fuzes
codex.quest.more_munitions.mg.title: Machine Gun
codex.quest.more_munitions.powder.text.0: Sixty-four charges. That's what one good evening uses.
codex.quest.more_munitions.powder.title: Powder Magazine
codex.quest.more_munitions.shells.text.0: Shrapnel, smoke, fluid. Not everything has to explode.
codex.quest.more_munitions.shells.title: Shell Rack
codex.quest.more_munitions.supply.text.0: The requester orders charges and shells from stock, the frogport delivers, the loader rams. The battery fires as long as there's powder in the warehouse.
codex.quest.more_munitions.supply.title: Battery Supply
codex.quest.more_qol2.compasses.text.0: Nature's Compass finds a biome by name, the Explorer's Compass a structure. Both show direction, distance and dimension.
codex.quest.more_qol2.compasses.text.1: In a world with a hundred biomes and fifty structure types that's the difference between 'found in a minute' and 'searched all evening'.
codex.quest.more_qol2.compasses.title: Compasses
codex.quest.more_qol2.enchdesc.task.0: Read: shift shows an enchantment's description
codex.quest.more_qol2.enchdesc.text.0: Enchantment Descriptions writes what each enchantment does straight into the tooltip. Hold shift over an enchanted book.
codex.quest.more_qol2.enchdesc.text.1: Polymorph beside it solves the other eternal problem of big packs: when five recipes match one crafting grid, it lets you pick.
codex.quest.more_qol2.enchdesc.title: Enchantment Descriptions
codex.quest.more_qol2.gadgets.text.0: The building gadget copies the block you aim at and lays it in rows, walls, stairs or across a surface. The exchanging gadget swaps one block for another across a whole wall. The destruction gadget clears a volume at once.
codex.quest.more_qol2.gadgets.text.1: The copy-paste gadget captures a build into a template and places it anywhere — Create's schematicannon, in your pocket.
codex.quest.more_qol2.gadgets.text.2: All gadgets run on FE, so wire them into the grid.
codex.quest.more_qol2.gadgets.title: Building Gadgets 2
codex.quest.more_qol2.hammers.text.0: A hammer breaks not a block but an area: three by three, then five by five, and the destructor five by five by five.
codex.quest.more_qol2.hammers.text.1: Shapes upgrade through cores, and the first core needs a finished netherite hammer — so it's a long road. After it, a quarry digs by hand.
codex.quest.more_qol2.hammers.title: Just Hammers
codex.quest.more_qol2.lootr2.text.0: A structure chest is personal now: every player opens their own loot and can't clean out someone else's.
codex.quest.more_qol2.lootr2.text.1: The mod counts the containers you've opened and hands you a Centennial Trophy at a hundred.
codex.quest.more_qol2.lootr2.title: Lootr
codex.quest.more_qol2.macaw.text.0: Seven mods, six thousand decorative blocks: roofs at real angles, doors in twenty styles, windows with shutters and curtains, openwork stairs, bridges with railings, lamps and holiday decor.
codex.quest.more_qol2.macaw.text.1: The roofing hammer reshapes a placed roof, pliers strip a bridge's railings, the key locks shutters.
codex.quest.more_qol2.macaw.title: The Macaw's Series
codex.quest.more_qol2.styles.task.0: Pick a new style when building the colony
codex.quest.more_qol2.styles.text.0: Ten new architectural styles for the colony: Aquatica, Steampunk, Frontier, Antique, Crimson Keep, Underwater Base, Hive, Corrupted, Tropical and Fairytale.
codex.quest.more_qol2.styles.text.1: Over four thousand blueprints. Colonies stop looking identical.
codex.quest.more_qol2.styles.title: Style Colonies
codex.quest.more_qol2.trash.text.0: A bin for items, one for fluids, one for energy and a universal one that eats all three.
codex.quest.more_qol2.trash.text.1: Each has a nine-slot filter with white and black lists. Your automation stops choking on cobblestone.
codex.quest.more_qol2.trash.title: Trash Cans
codex.quest.more_rails.couplers.text.0: Four couplers — four wagons. Trains of different length on one track.
codex.quest.more_rails.couplers.title: Couplers
codex.quest.more_rails.crossing.text.0: Where the road meets the track.
codex.quest.more_rails.crossing.title: Crossing
codex.quest.more_rails.depot.text.0: Three trains with schedules, a handcar for track inspection, a conductor on each. Turn in four caps — you have a staff.
codex.quest.more_rails.depot.title: Depot
codex.quest.more_rails.fuel.text.0: A fuel tank and a diesel stack. A train without coal.
codex.quest.more_rails.fuel.title: Diesel
codex.quest.more_rails.locomotive.text.0: Smokestack, boiler, smokebox, plating. A locomotive that looks like a locomotive.
codex.quest.more_rails.locomotive.title: Steam Locomotive
codex.quest.more_rails.semaphore.text.0: Arms instead of lamps. Work like signals, look like history.
codex.quest.more_rails.semaphore.title: Semaphores
codex.quest.more_vanilla.beacon.text.0: A nether star and a pyramid. Speed across the whole base — a small MekaSuit module many hours before MekaSuit.
codex.quest.more_vanilla.beacon.title: Beacon
codex.quest.more_vanilla.diamonds.text.0: At minus fifty-eight. A pickaxe, then everything else.
codex.quest.more_vanilla.diamonds.title: Diamonds
codex.quest.more_vanilla.elytra2.text.0: Sixty-four rockets. Until flight modules are far off, this is the sky.
codex.quest.more_vanilla.elytra2.title: Elytra and Rockets
codex.quest.more_vanilla.enchant.text.0: Fifteen shelves, lapis, luck. Eternal Tales' astral enchanter will later do what this table can't.
codex.quest.more_vanilla.enchant.title: Enchanting Table
Four scraps, four gold. One thing for yourself, the rest into the diving set and cannons.
codex.quest.more_vanilla.netherite.title: Netherite
codex.quest.more_vanilla.trims.task.1: Apply a trim to any armor
codex.quest.more_vanilla.trims.text.0: Trim templates — vanilla and modded: Eternal Tales adds sixty materials and thirty patterns.
codex.quest.more_vanilla.trims.title: Armor Trims
Emeralds and villagers in Easy Villagers blocks. A librarian with Mending is goal number one.
codex.quest.more_vanilla.villagers.title: Trade
codex.quest.offroad.borehead.text.0: A rock-cutting wheel on a physics chassis. The tunnel closes with darkness behind you.
codex.quest.offroad.borehead.title: Borehead
codex.quest.offroad.tires.text.0: Small, regular, large, monstrous. Sticky versions — Sticky Wheels — hold slope and ice.
codex.quest.offroad.tires.title: Tires
codex.quest.offroad.vehicle.text.0: Frame, four mounts with tires, engine, controls, a directional gearshift for steering — and the assembler. Across Terralith's hills on wheels.
codex.quest.offroad.vehicle.title: First Vehicle
codex.quest.offroad.wheel_mount.text.0: Wheel on axle, rotation on wheel. Four — a car.
codex.quest.offroad.wheel_mount.title: Wheel Mount
codex.quest.radar.controllers.text.0: Auto yaw and pitch controllers aim the mount at a target from the radar. The fire controller gives the shot command with lead.
codex.quest.radar.controllers.title: Targeting Controllers
codex.quest.radar.datalink.text.0: The data link connects radar, monitor and controllers. Filters (target, ident, network) weed out clutter.
codex.quest.radar.datalink.title: Data Link
codex.quest.radar.guidance.text.0: The guided fuze walks a shell onto the mark the radar is holding. The radar warning receiver screams when someone else's beam finds you first, and the identification transponder keeps your own battery from mistaking you for a target.
codex.quest.radar.guidance.title: Shell Guidance
codex.quest.radar.iff.text.0: The transponder marks your object as friendly, the safe zone designator excludes an area from fire, the RWR warns you're being painted by someone else's radar.
codex.quest.radar.iff.title: Friend or Foe
codex.quest.radar.misc_radar.text.0: Binoculars zoom and highlight targets; the radio carries voice and signals over distance.
codex.quest.radar.misc_radar.title: Miscellany
codex.quest.radar.plate.text.0: The antenna is assembled from plates; more area, longer range. The dish is the compact option.
codex.quest.radar.plate.title: Radar Plates
codex.quest.radar.radar.text.0: The radar detects moving physics objects and creatures in its sector and passes coordinates over the data line.
codex.quest.radar.radar.title: Radar
codex.quest.rs_autocraft.autocrafter.tex: Stores patterns, executes. For machines — hands components to a neighbor and waits for the result.
codex.quest.rs_autocraft.big_project.tex: Order eight advanced processors with one click. Silicon, gold, redstone, blanks, furnace — if the network assembled this itself, it's configured.
codex.quest.rs_autocraft.jei_rs.task.0: Order a craft from JEI through the grid
codex.quest.rs_autocraft.jei_rs.text.0: From a JEI recipe straight to an order in the network. The grid highlights what's missing.
codex.quest.rs_autocraft.jei_rs.title: JEI Integration
codex.quest.rs_autocraft.manager.text.0: All patterns in one list; duplicates and conflicts visible at once.
codex.quest.rs_autocraft.manager.title: Pattern Manager
codex.quest.rs_autocraft.monitor_craft.t: What's being made, what's waiting, what's stuck.
codex.quest.rs_autocraft.pattern_grid.te: A recipe is written onto a pattern. Crafting table, furnace, crusher, any machine with a filter — all can be described.
codex.quest.rs_autocraft.upgrade_craft.t: In an exporter or interface: no item — the network makes it. That's how you keep a stock you don't think about.
The same monitor, in your pocket.
codex.quest.rs_network.blocks_storage.te: A disk that became a block. No drive needed.
codex.quest.rs_network.cable.text.0: The cable connects. The relay switches a segment on and off by condition.
codex.quest.rs_network.cable.title: Cables and Relay
The constructor places blocks from the network into the world, the destructor breaks and stores. A wall that builds itself.
codex.quest.rs_network.constructor.title: Constructor and Destructor
codex.quest.rs_network.controller.text.0: The heart. Takes energy, hands it to all who are connected. One network — one controller; more devices, more it eats.
codex.quest.rs_network.controller.title: Controller
codex.quest.rs_network.drive.text.0: Eight disks in one block. One, four, sixteen, sixty-four thousand items. The housing lets you take a disk apart again.
codex.quest.rs_network.drive.title: Disk Drive and Disks
codex.quest.rs_network.external.text.0: Chest, barrel, Create vault, tank — all become part of the network. The disk interface pours between disks.
codex.quest.rs_network.external.title: External Storage
codex.quest.rs_network.grid.text.0: A window into the network: search, sort, move. The crafting grid adds a table, the pattern grid writes recipes. Portable — in your pocket on a battery.
codex.quest.rs_network.grid.title: Grid
codex.quest.rs_network.io.text.0: Importer takes, exporter gives by filter, interface goes both ways. Upgrades: speed, stack, regulator, silk, fortune.
codex.quest.rs_network.io.title: Import and Export
codex.quest.rs_network.monitor.text.0: A number on a block. A signal at a threshold.
codex.quest.rs_network.monitor.title: Monitor and Detector
Quartz and iron. Cables, housings, everything.
codex.quest.rs_network.quartz_iron.title: Quartz Enriched Iron
codex.quest.rs_network.security.title: Security
codex.quest.rs_network.silicon.text.0: Quartz to silicon, silicon with iron or gold to a blank, blank into the furnace. Three tiers of processors — the consumable of the whole network.
codex.quest.rs_network.silicon.title: Silicon and Processors
codex.quest.rs_network.wireless.text.0: The transmitter gives coverage, the grid opens the network from anywhere. Network transmitter and receiver link segments — even across dimensions.
codex.quest.rs_network.wireless.title: Wireless Access
codex.quest.space_glacio.colony.reward.0: A second homeland, built with your own hands
codex.quest.space_glacio.colony.text.0: A full base on another planet: oxygen distributor, pump, gravity normalizer, solar panels, airlocks and an energizer.
codex.quest.space_glacio.colony.text.1: Gather it all on one planet — and you never have to come home again.
codex.quest.space_glacio.colony.title: A Colony Off Earth
codex.quest.space_glacio.glacio_life.tex: Glacian rams give fur, ice goes to cryo fuel, and every ore appears here at once. The best place for a second base.
codex.quest.space_glacio.interstellar.te: You can take the suit off: the temperature is within range and there's air. After Venus it feels like a holiday.
A pad and return fuel are in the rocket
The list that saves lives. Into the rocket's inventory: a second launch pad and three buckets of fuel for the return. On you: full tanks, food, weapons and — without fail — soul torches or glowstone.
Ordinary torches break in vacuum, water evaporates, plants die. Forgetting the pad means staying on the Moon forever.
codex.quest.space_ground.checklist.title: Pre-flight Check
codex.quest.space_ground.compressor.text: Two pistons and six iron ingots. An ingot goes in, a plate comes out; a block goes in, nine plates come out.
Plates go into everything, so the compressor sits beside the generator and never gets switched off.
codex.quest.space_ground.furnace.text.0: An upgraded blast furnace with two modes: smelting four times faster than usual and — the point — alloying.
codex.quest.space_ground.furnace.text.1: Iron plus coal in alloy mode gives steel. It's the mod's only steel recipe, and it's the bottleneck of the whole space program.
codex.quest.space_ground.furnace.title: Etrionic Blast Furnace
Six iron ingots, a coal block and a furnace. Twenty energy per tick from anything that burns — at the start there simply are no other sources.
All Ad Astra machinery runs on its own energy, but the socket is shared with Create Addition and Mekanism: a cable will reach.
codex.quest.space_ground.generator.title: Coal Generator
codex.quest.space_ground.oil.text.0: Oil wells gush in Earth's oceans — visible from far off. Oil doesn't regenerate, so pump extra.
codex.quest.space_ground.oil.text.1: The fuel refinery converts oil to fuel one to one. Three buckets of fuel is one launch.
codex.quest.space_ground.oil.title: Oil
codex.quest.space_ground.oxygen.text.0: Oxygen is extracted from water: a hundred millibuckets of water yield four of oxygen. The ratio is brutal, so run a pump or a Create pipe to the loader right away.
codex.quest.space_ground.oxygen.text.1: Finished oxygen goes into tanks and fills your suit.
codex.quest.space_ground.oxygen.title: Oxygen
codex.quest.space_ground.rocket.reward.0: A second pad — so you have something to come back on
codex.quest.space_ground.rocket.text.0: A nose cone with a lightning rod, six steel blocks, four fins, two tanks and a steel engine — all into the NASA workbench at once.
codex.quest.space_ground.rocket.text.1: A three-by-three launch pad, rocket in the center, fuel inside. Jump in the cockpit opens the planet map.
codex.quest.space_ground.rocket.title: Tier One Rocket
codex.quest.space_ground.steel.text.0: A tier one rocket eats about ninety steel ingots. That's sixty-four pieces of iron and as much coal, run through the furnace one at a time.
codex.quest.space_ground.steel.text.1: Automate the feed early — Create or Mekanism will handle it, and you'll save yourself an hour of clicking.
codex.quest.space_ground.steel.title: Steel
codex.quest.space_ground.suit.text.0: Four pieces: helmet, suit, pants, boots. Only the full set works — three quarters of a suit saves nothing at all.
codex.quest.space_ground.suit.text.1: The plain suit handles cold and lets you breathe. It won't handle Venus: that needs the netherite one.
codex.quest.space_ground.suit.title: Space Suit
The table rockets are built on. Fourteen slots, each waiting for its part: nose cone, six steel blocks, four fins, two tanks and an engine.
codex.quest.space_ground.workbench.title: NASA Workbench
codex.quest.space_hot.calorite.text.0: Found on Venus and nowhere else. It makes the tier four rocket and the jet suit.
codex.quest.space_hot.calorite.title: Calorite
codex.quest.space_hot.jet.text.0: Calorite over the netherite suit, a calorite engine and an etrionic capacitor. It flies on energy: jump to rise, jump with sprint to accelerate.
codex.quest.space_hot.jet.text.1: The mod's top armor and the most convenient way to cross any planet.
codex.quest.space_hot.jet.title: Jet Suit
codex.quest.space_hot.mercury.text.0: The planet closest to the sun and the best place for solar panels in the whole pack. Iron is the only ore, but there's so much energy that a factory on Mercury pays for itself.
codex.quest.space_hot.mercury.title: Mercury
codex.quest.space_hot.tier4.text.0: Calorite tanks and engine. The mod's last rocket — and the only one with the range for another star.
codex.quest.space_hot.tier4.title: Tier Four Rocket
codex.quest.space_hot.venus.text.0: Acid rain corrodes everything living, pygros attack in packs, sulfur creepers burst in a cloud of poison.
codex.quest.space_hot.venus.text.1: You don't come here without the netherite suit. At all.
codex.quest.space_hot.venus.title: Planet of Storms
codex.quest.space_mars.cryo.text.0: The cryo freezer turns ice shards into cryo fuel: forty shards per bucket.
codex.quest.space_mars.cryo.text.1: A launch on it costs one bucket instead of three. A full rocket tank is three flights, and that's worth the fuss with ice.
codex.quest.space_mars.cryo.title: Cryo Fuel
codex.quest.space_mars.energizer.text.0: Two million energy in one block, and the charge survives being mined. Right-click an item to charge it.
codex.quest.space_mars.energizer.title: Energizer
codex.quest.space_mars.landing_mars.text: Colder than the Moon, and still no air. But there are temples, martian raptors and ore right in the canyon walls.
codex.quest.space_mars.netherite_suit.te: Ostrum plates over netherite armor and a large gas tank. Handles heat, grants permanent fire resistance and holds more oxygen.
Without it Venus kills you in seconds. The mod has tested this.
codex.quest.space_mars.ostrum.text.0: Martian ore. Ostrum makes the cryo freezer, the energizer, pipes and, above all, the netherite space suit.
codex.quest.space_mars.ostrum.title: Ostrum
codex.quest.space_mars.tier3.text.0: Ostrum tanks and engine. Opens Venus and Mercury.
codex.quest.space_mars.tier3.title: Tier Three Rocket
codex.quest.space_moon.cheese.text.0: Yes, the Moon has cheese ore. No, it isn't a mod joke — it's the mod's one joke, seen through to the end.
codex.quest.space_moon.cheese.title: Cheese
codex.quest.space_moon.desh.text.0: Lunar ore sits at any depth, but is richest below zero. Desh goes into advanced machines, space stations and the tier two rocket.
codex.quest.space_moon.desh.text.1: While you're at it, look for ice shards: they later become cryo fuel, three times more economical than the ordinary kind.
codex.quest.space_moon.desh.title: Desh
The heart of any base off Earth. In a fully sealed room it creates a liveable zone and evens out the temperature too.
The limit is six thousand blocks. The 'show' button highlights the volume and finds holes: one gap and everything blows out in a vortex.
A water pump over an infinite source feeds it forever.
codex.quest.space_moon.distributor.title: Oxygen Distributor
codex.quest.space_moon.gadgets.text.0: The TI-69 shows oxygen, temperature and gravity where you stand. The zip gun pushes you with a jet of oxygen — in orbital weightlessness it's the only way to move.
codex.quest.space_moon.gadgets.title: Instruments
codex.quest.space_moon.gravity.text.0: From zero to two g inside a sealed volume. Walking your base at a normal pace is a small luxury that costs energy.
codex.quest.space_moon.gravity.title: Gravity Normalizer
codex.quest.space_moon.landing.text.0: The lander sets you down softly. Shift and right-click to take its contents, punch it to break the lander itself.
codex.quest.space_moon.landing.text.1: First thing: look around and put the pad back down. It's your ticket home.
codex.quest.space_moon.landing.title: One Small Step
codex.quest.space_moon.orbit.text.0: A space station isn't crafted: you order it right on the planet map if the materials are in your inventory. Even Earth orbit asks for desh — so stations open only after the Moon.
codex.quest.space_moon.orbit.text.1: There's no air and no gravity in orbit. Without a zip gun you simply drift away.
codex.quest.space_moon.orbit.title: Orbit
codex.quest.space_moon.rover.text.0: Two seats, sixteen slots and a radio that picks up real internet stations. Runs on the same fuel as rockets.
codex.quest.space_moon.rover.text.1: It runs over mobs. On the Moon that's occasionally the only argument.
codex.quest.space_moon.rover.title: Rover
codex.quest.space_moon.solar.text.0: The sun shines brighter on the Moon than on Earth and the panel gives more. This is where the lunar grid begins.
codex.quest.space_moon.solar.text.1: Cables run through special ducts: a plain cable in a wall breaks the seal.
codex.quest.space_moon.solar.title: Solar Panel
codex.quest.space_moon.tier2.text.0: Same layout, but tanks and engine are desh. The nose cone and fins stay steel at every tier.
codex.quest.space_moon.tier2.title: Tier Two Rocket
codex.quest.start_first_day.backpack.tex: Leather, string, a few planks — and twenty-seven slots you never have to hunt through chests for. Opens with B, and grows over time: copper, iron, gold, diamond, netherite — losing nothing on each upgrade.
codex.quest.start_first_day.backpack_upg: A backpack isn't a bag, it's a machine. Pickup catches drops straight into it, magnet pulls items from afar, smelting turns ore into ingots on the walk home. Advanced versions add filters: pick up only what you want.
The first two — pickup and magnet — change how a mine feels more than a diamond pickaxe does.
codex.quest.start_first_day.base.task.0: A base site has been chosen
codex.quest.start_first_day.base.text.0: Choosing the site is the one first-day decision you can't undo. Look for flat ground at least 48 by 48: Create sprawls. Water and lava nearby. A forest. And spare land for the colony — it'll need a lot.
codex.quest.start_first_day.base.text.1: Building Gadgets 2 copies and places blocks in rows and whole templates. With it the first house goes up in an evening, not a weekend.
codex.quest.start_first_day.base.title: A Place for a Base
codex.quest.start_first_day.carry.task.0: Carry a chest with items using Carry On
codex.quest.start_first_day.carry.text.0: Crouch, right-click a chest with an empty hand — and it's above your head, contents and all. Same with furnaces, barrels, chickens and, if you insist, the village trader.
codex.quest.start_first_day.carry.text.1: Carry On is one of those mods you don't notice until you move house. After it, the thought 'take apart and rebuild' simply stops occurring.
codex.quest.start_first_day.carry.title: Carrying Things by Hand
codex.quest.start_first_day.crafting.tex: Crafting table, wooden pickaxe, stone axe. A ritual you know by heart — and the only time the pack hides nothing from you.
There will be thousands of recipes soon. Don't memorize them: JEI remembers for you. R over an item — how to make it; U — where it's used.
codex.quest.start_first_day.death.task.0: Read: the corpse with your items stays where you died
codex.quest.start_first_day.death.text.0: When you die — and you will — a corpse stays where you fell. Everything from your inventory is in it, and nothing burns or vanishes after five minutes. Coordinates arrive in chat.
codex.quest.start_first_day.death.text.1: Only the owner can loot it. The only way to lose your inventory in this pack is to forget where you were going.
codex.quest.start_first_day.death.title: Death Is Not Loss
codex.quest.start_first_day.iron.text.0: The caves look unfamiliar — Terralith reshaped the terrain — but ore follows the old rules. Thirty-two ingots: not wealth yet, but already currency.
codex.quest.start_first_day.iron.text.1: Everyone in this pack wants iron at once. Create for andesite alloy, Immersive Engineering for the hammer, Mekanism for its first machines. Stockpile.
codex.quest.start_first_day.iron.title: Iron Age
codex.quest.start_first_day.jade.task.0: Aim at a block and see the Jade tooltip
codex.quest.start_first_day.jade.text.0: Aim at anything — Jade tells you what it is, which mod it's from, how much liquid is inside, a machine's progress, and how many hearts the thing staring at you has. In a ninety-mod pack that isn't convenience, it's eyesight.
codex.quest.start_first_day.jade.title: What Is This Block
codex.quest.start_first_day.map.task.0: Open the full map and set a waypoint at your base
codex.quest.start_first_day.map.text.0: Xaero's map draws itself as you walk. M opens it full-screen, N lists waypoints. A waypoint is set with B, and one appears automatically where you died — in case the corpse needs finding.
codex.quest.start_first_day.map.title: World Map
codex.quest.start_first_day.night.text.0: Night here isn't a pause, it's half the game: mutants, raiders and whatever comes out of the other mods. The Comforts sleeping bag skips it without touching your spawn point — what you want on a first trek.
codex.quest.start_first_day.night.text.1: The hammock does the opposite: skips the day. For those who hunt at night.
codex.quest.start_first_day.night.title: Surviving the Night
codex.quest.start_first_day.waystone.tex: Waystones stand across the world like markers of a forgotten road. Click one you find — it remembers you, and you it: from any other stone you can return here.
Your own stone is made from stone and obsidian. Place it by your home before you go far: rule number one for everyone who goes far.
codex.quest.start_first_day.wood.text.0: An oak doesn't fall at once. The first hit takes one layer, the second another, and only when the trunk is properly cut does the crown crash down. That's TreeChop: a tree here has weight.
codex.quest.start_first_day.wood.text.1: No time to admire it? Crouch and hit again — the tree drops whole. Sixteen logs and you can build.
codex.quest.start_first_day.wood.title: The First Tree
codex.quest.start_qol.almanac.text.0: Almanac tells you which biome a plant grows in — a lifesaver for Eternal Tales and Botania flora. Sable adds small ambient touches.
codex.quest.start_qol.almanac.title: Almanac and Sable
A Create farm, a Mekanism reactor and a colony only live while their chunk is loaded. A loader holds it while you're away. Without one, any automation is an illusion.
codex.quest.start_qol.chunkloaders.title: Chunk Loaders
codex.quest.start_qol.easyvillagers.text: Pick a villager up and put him in a block: trader, breeder, incubator. Three in an iron farm — and the farm is done without a single redstone block.
codex.quest.start_qol.gadgets.text.0: The building gadget copies the block you aim at and lays it in rows, the copy gadget captures a whole build into a template and places it again, the destruction gadget clears a wall in one motion.
codex.quest.start_qol.gadgets.text.1: It runs on energy or on materials from your inventory — your choice. A house that takes an evening by hand takes minutes here.
codex.quest.start_qol.gadgets.title: Building Gadgets 2
Sort in any container, auto-refill stacks, an 'everything into the chest' button. A week without it is hard.
codex.quest.start_qol.inventoryqol.title: Inventory QoL
codex.quest.start_qol.jei.task.0: Find any item's recipe via JEI
codex.quest.start_qol.jei.text.0: The pack's main reference. R — how to make, U — where to use. Search understands prefixes: @mod, #tag, $tab. Refined Storage is wired in directly: request a craft into the network from the recipe window.
codex.quest.start_qol.jei.title: JEI
codex.quest.start_qol.keyconflict.text.0: Ninety mods won't fit on one keyboard. When several actions land on one key, a selection wheel appears. The Codex lives on K — rebind if it's crowded.
codex.quest.start_qol.keyconflict.title: Key Conflict Wheel
codex.quest.start_qol.lootr.text.0: Structure chests are personal now: every player sees their own loot and can't clean out someone else's. On a server this removes the main source of grudges.
codex.quest.start_qol.lootr.title: Lootr
codex.quest.start_qol.mousetweaks.text.0: Drag with LMB held — stacks move. RMB — one at a time. Wheel — between inventories. Fingers learn faster than heads.
codex.quest.start_qol.mousetweaks.title: Mouse Tweaks
codex.quest.start_qol.performance.text.0: ModernFix, FerriteCore, Lithium, C2ME, Krypton, Noisium, ServerCore, AllTheLeaks and NoTick are installed and tuned. Distant Horizons draws the horizon beyond render distance; the first pass over terrain is slow, then the map lives locally.
codex.quest.start_qol.performance.text.1: The pack is large: a hundred and fifty mods, half of them computing something every tick. If it dips, /spark profiler names the culprit in a minute.
codex.quest.start_qol.performance.title: Performance
A filtered disposal. Deletes only what it's told — and nothing else.
codex.quest.start_qol.smartdeleter.title: Smart Item Deleter
codex.quest.start_qol.treechop2.text.0: Layered chopping, whole-tree felling, tool durability — all in the config.
codex.quest.start_qol.treechop2.title: TreeChop
codex.quest.start_qol.voicechat.text.0: V opens settings. Sound is positional: the closer, the louder.
codex.quest.start_qol.voicechat.title: Voice Chat
Smelting, blasting, smoking on the move. A crafting table and anvil inside. A brewing stand. Compacting ore into blocks. The backpack becomes a small base.
codex.quest.storage_local.backpack_filte: The filter sifts junk, void destroys it, deposit dumps into a chest, refill keeps the hotbar full. Pump — fluids, battery — energy.
codex.quest.storage_local.backpack_tiers: Copper, iron, gold, diamond, netherite. Each tier — more slots and more upgrades, and nothing lost along the way.
codex.quest.storage_local.bins.text.0: One item, but very many. Cobblestone, wood, ore.
codex.quest.storage_local.bins.title: Mekanism Bins
codex.quest.storage_local.everlasting.te: Won't burn and won't vanish. Insurance against lava.
codex.quest.storage_local.rack.text.0: The colony warehouse — also external storage for the network.
codex.quest.storage_local.rack.title: Colony Racks
codex.quest.storage_local.vault_create.t: Cheap, big, and joins the network via external storage. A raw-material warehouse before a real network.
codex.quest.story_colony.fifty.text.0: Fifty citizens, a level-five town hall in the plans, a mystical site for happiness. A city.
codex.quest.story_colony.fifty.title: Fifty
codex.quest.story_colony.found.text.0: Chest, town hall, builder, first house. Four citizens who have nothing yet but you.
codex.quest.story_colony.found.title: Four
codex.quest.story_colony.garrison.text.0: Barracks with four towers, academy, archery. Eight guards by advancement — and the night no longer frightens.
codex.quest.story_colony.garrison.title: Garrison
codex.quest.story_colony.guard.text.0: Two towers and a rally banner. The raid comes sooner than you think.
codex.quest.story_colony.guard.title: First Night Under Guard
codex.quest.story_colony.industry.text.0: Smeltery, blacksmith, mechanic. The mechanic can make Create and IE parts — teach him, and the colony starts supplying the factory.
codex.quest.story_colony.industry.title: Smithy and Mechanic
codex.quest.story_colony.network.text.0: Refined Storage external storage on the warehouse racks. Now everything the colony brings shows in the grid — and vice versa.
codex.quest.story_colony.network.title: Warehouse on the Network
codex.quest.story_colony.population.text: Tavern, more houses, hospital. Twenty-five citizens is a town with character.
codex.quest.story_colony.science.text.0: Library, school, university. First research started.
codex.quest.story_colony.science.title: University
codex.quest.story_colony.supply.text.0: Warehouse, courier, farmer, cook. Turn in sixty-four bread — the colony must eat while you build.
codex.quest.story_colony.supply.title: Warehouse and Bread
codex.quest.story_colony.technopolis.tex: Level-five town hall. A colony that feeds the factory and defends itself. Turn in eight Mekanism ultimate circuits made by the mechanic's hands or yours — no matter; what matters is both sides reached the end.
codex.quest.story_colony.wood.text.0: Lumberjack, sawmill, miner, stonemason. This is where the colony gets everything it builds.
codex.quest.story_colony.wood.title: Forest and Stone
codex.quest.story_current.alternator.tex: A Create Addition alternator on a steam boiler. Rotation goes into wire, wire into an IE capacitor. The first handshake between Create and IE.
codex.quest.story_current.coke.text.0: IE's first step is always coke. Turn in sixty-four — the book needs to know the oven breathes, not just stands.
codex.quest.story_current.coke.title: Smoke Over the Coke Oven
codex.quest.story_current.diesel.text.0: The cloche grows, squeezer and fermenter process, the refinery mixes, the generator roars. Turn in sixteen buckets of biodiesel — the grid must survive the night.
codex.quest.story_current.diesel.title: Diesel
codex.quest.story_current.dynamo.text.0: An IE water wheel on a dynamo, copper wire to a capacitor. Little, but already energy — the kind Mekanism understands.
codex.quest.story_current.dynamo.title: First Current
codex.quest.story_current.fission.text.0: Fission reactor, boiler, turbine, matrix. Three mods, one wire, a gigawatt. Turn in four fuel assemblies — spares, not the ones in the reactor.
codex.quest.story_current.fission.title: Heart of the Base
codex.quest.story_current.grid.text.0: A transformer raises voltage, steel wire carries it across the yard, a Mekanism energy cube receives. One meter for three mods.
codex.quest.story_current.grid.title: One Grid
codex.quest.story_current.ore5.text.0: The grid exists — now there's something to feed. Mekanism's full chain: dissolution, washing, crystallization. Turn in sixty-four iron crystals — proof the setup lives.
codex.quest.story_current.ore5.title: Fivefold Ore
codex.quest.story_current.steel.text.0: The pack has two steels, and they aren't interchangeable. IE's blast furnace and Mekanism's infuser — build both. This node is the first place two mods stand on one pad.
codex.quest.story_current.steel.title: Steel of Two Houses
Sorcery level thirteen. Labyrinth, secret, Xaxxas.
codex.quest.story_expedition.amber.title: Amber
codex.quest.story_expedition.comets.text: Sorcery level two, five components, a crystal. A pink sky and a tree that answers an axe.
codex.quest.story_expedition.dusk.text.0: Twilight Forest second: strict but fair. Naga in the courtyard, Lich in the tower. After them the forest opens.
codex.quest.story_expedition.dusk.title: Twilight
codex.quest.story_expedition.eden.text.0: The sunstone opens the portal in the End. The Sunfurry pour the Drink of the Sun if you've earned it.
codex.quest.story_expedition.eden.title: Eden
codex.quest.story_expedition.karvat.text: Gods on altars. At least three of five.
codex.quest.story_expedition.kit.text.0: A waystone at home, two return scrolls, a charm of life from the Twilight Forest — no, not yet. For now: stone, scrolls, a sleeping bag and a promise to yourself not to forget coordinates.
codex.quest.story_expedition.kit.title: Kit
codex.quest.story_expedition.purg.text.0: Hellrock from the altar, the Rock Blaze, three rune parts, Nyetet. It's dark here, and the exiles tell you why.
codex.quest.story_expedition.purg.title: Purgatorium
codex.quest.story_expedition.rayana.text: Jungles and vampires. The Bloody Eye on the Aede altar — Pterion.
codex.quest.story_expedition.sky.text.0: Aether first: gentler than the rest, and it teaches the main thing — watch your feet. Bronze dungeon, key, medal.
codex.quest.story_expedition.sky.title: Sky
codex.quest.story_expedition.unahzaal.re: The expedition is over. Another game begins
codex.quest.story_expedition.unahzaal.te: All crystals into one. Level sixteen. The multiverse and the one who holds it.
codex.quest.story_expedition.volcanech.t: The aggressor world. Golem, sulfur TNT, deserters, Arahulum.
codex.quest.story_forge.boiler.text.0: Tank, four burners, four engines. Boiler level grows with volume and heat; your first will be level two, and that's enough to stop the windmill for good.
codex.quest.story_forge.boiler.title: Boiler to Eighteen
codex.quest.story_forge.hand.text.0: The first turn of a shaft is always yours. A press on a hand crank, ten iron sheets, blisters. Remember the feeling: water will replace it soon.
codex.quest.story_forge.hand.title: Hand on the Crank
codex.quest.story_forge.mill.text.0: The fast path — a millstone, cheap and slow. It gives the first hundred crushed pieces and shows that ore can double.
codex.quest.story_forge.mill.title: Millstone or Wheels
codex.quest.story_forge.precision.text.0: Five crafters in a ring, deployers with gold sheet, rods and cogs, a belt around. Turn in eight mechanisms assembled without hands.
codex.quest.story_forge.precision.title: Precision Line
codex.quest.story_forge.rails.text.0: Sixty-four tracks from base to mine. Not straight — Create does lovely curves, and the first tracks take longer than needed simply because it's nice to watch.
codex.quest.story_forge.rails.title: First Line
codex.quest.story_forge.smelt.text.0: A fan over lava, a belt under it, a chest at the end. Crushed goes in, ingots come out. The first place on the base where nothing needs hands.
codex.quest.story_forge.smelt.title: Smelting Row
codex.quest.story_forge.source.text.0: Either path leads here: to a stressometer whose needle, for the first time, isn't in the red. Now you can place machines, not toys.
codex.quest.story_forge.source.title: Source Found
codex.quest.story_forge.source_w.text.0: A twin of the node above: the fork rejoins. The book counts whichever path you took.
codex.quest.story_forge.source_w.title: Source Found
codex.quest.story_forge.train.reward.0: The first achievement that moves by itself
codex.quest.story_forge.train.text.0: A locomotive with a boiler, a wagon with portable interfaces, a schedule: 'to the mine, wait for full, home, wait for empty, repeat'. A conductor in a cap. Step back and watch it leave.
codex.quest.story_forge.train.title: A Train That Doesn't Wait
codex.quest.story_forge.water.text.0: Two large wheels in a closed channel. Quieter than a windmill, more reliable, weather-proof. Classic.
codex.quest.story_forge.water.title: The Way of Water
codex.quest.story_forge.wheels.text.0: The long path — brass, crushing wheels, a stream. Pricier going in, five times faster coming out. Turn in one hundred twenty-eight crushed iron from the wheels — and the book believes the line works.
codex.quest.story_forge.wheels.title: Millstone or Wheels
codex.quest.story_forge.wind.text.0: A bearing, sixty-four sail frames, a high point. A windmill needs nothing but sky, and for that it's forgiven its slowness.
codex.quest.story_forge.wind.title: The Way of Wind
codex.quest.story_sky.cast.text.0: Cast iron, sand, molds, drill. Turn in four bored cast-iron barrels — with them you can already shoot.
codex.quest.story_sky.cast.title: Casting
codex.quest.story_sky.eyes.text.0: Radar, plates, data link, monitor. The first time you see the target before it sees you.
codex.quest.story_sky.eyes.title: Eyes
codex.quest.story_sky.flak.text.0: An autocannon with a steel barrel and flak rounds. Turn in sixty-four — against air targets you don't bring fewer.
codex.quest.story_sky.flak.title: Anti-Air
codex.quest.story_sky.fleet.text.0: An airship with a gyroscope, portable engine, navigation table, an autocannon on deck and a launcher under the gondola. A transponder — so your own AA doesn't shoot it down. Turn in four gyroscopic mechanisms: a fleet needs stability.
codex.quest.story_sky.fleet.title: Flagship
codex.quest.story_sky.lift.text.0: Assembler, levitite, envelope, burner. The first airship is a wooden box that flies anyway.
codex.quest.story_sky.lift.title: Ascent
codex.quest.story_sky.missile.text.0: Motor, fins, computer, proximity fuze, launcher. A missile is a physics object, and it flies for real.
codex.quest.story_sky.missile.title: Missile
codex.quest.story_sky.mount.text.0: Mount, yaw and pitch controllers, fire controller. The radar speaks — the gun turns. No hand at all.
codex.quest.story_sky.mount.title: Aiming
codex.quest.tech2_foregoing.animals.text: The rancher milks cows and shears sheep without touching the animals. The feeder breeds them automatically.
The slaughter factory and mob crusher turn a farm into a source of meat, experience and pink slime.
codex.quest.tech2_foregoing.farm.text.0: The sower plants across an area, the gatherer harvests everything it can reach, whole trees included.
codex.quest.tech2_foregoing.farm.text.1: The mod's fertilizer speeds growth. The farm ends up compact and fully autonomous.
codex.quest.tech2_foregoing.farm.title: Auto Farm
Four tiers: pity, simple, advanced, supreme. Each machine wants a frame of its tier, and that's the mod's only progression.
codex.quest.tech2_foregoing.frames.title: Machine Frames
codex.quest.tech2_foregoing.laser.text.0: The laser base fires into bedrock and pulls ore back out. Lenses decide which ore: the rarer it is, the more lenses of the right colour you need.
codex.quest.tech2_foregoing.laser.text.1: It's an endless source of any resource and the main reason to install the mod.
codex.quest.tech2_foregoing.laser.title: Laser Drilling
codex.quest.tech2_foregoing.latex.text.0: The tree fluid extractor taps latex from logs, the processing unit boils it into dry rubber, and rubber becomes plastic.
codex.quest.tech2_foregoing.latex.text.1: Plastic is the material of every frame and half the mod's machines.
codex.quest.tech2_foregoing.latex.title: Latex
codex.quest.tech2_foregoing.ore_meat.tex: The strangest ore processing in the pack: ore is washed in meat, aged in a fermenter and sieved into dust.
The yield is three to five ingots per ore, depending on how long it aged. The fermentation station wants a hot block below it and a cold one beside it.
codex.quest.tech2_foregoing.stonework.te: One machine that turns water and lava into cobble, stone, brick, glass and everything cut from them. Placed once, it feeds construction for the rest of the game.
codex.quest.tech2_mektools.glowstone.tex: Speed fifteen against netherite's nine — the fastest tool in the pack. The durability doesn't last, but it cuts like a knife through butter.
Its armor glows and, like gold, appeals to piglins.
codex.quest.tech2_mektools.lapis.text.0: Laughable durability, but enchantability of thirty-two — twice gold's.
codex.quest.tech2_mektools.lapis.text.1: It isn't a working tool but a cheap way to roll good enchantments and anvil them onto something decent.
codex.quest.tech2_mektools.lapis.title: Lapis Lazuli
codex.quest.tech2_mektools.obsidian.text: Four thousand durability, plus eight damage, thirty-one protection against netherite's twenty and toughness of five.
It's the pack's best ordinary gear — nothing compares until supremium and the MekaSuit.
codex.quest.tech2_mektools.osmium.text.0: A thousand durability and plus four damage — osmium already matches netherite on damage, and efficiency enchantments cover the slowness.
codex.quest.tech2_mektools.osmium.text.1: The paxel combines pickaxe, axe and shovel: one slot instead of three.
codex.quest.tech2_mektools.osmium.title: Osmium
codex.quest.tech2_mektools.shield.text.0: A shield from any of the mod's materials. The obsidian one takes one thousand six hundred eighty hits against a vanilla shield's three hundred thirty-six.
codex.quest.tech2_mektools.shield.title: Shields
codex.quest.tech2_newage.coil.text.0: Eight copper ingots around an andesite alloy block. The coil turns rotation into electricity, but only with magnets around it.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.coil.text.1: Magnet strength decides everything: magnetite gives one, netherite twenty-four. Carbon brushes draw current from eight coils at once.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.coil.title: Generator Coil
It 'overcharges' items on the depot below. Iron at a thousand becomes overcharged, gold at two thousand, diamond at ten.
Overcharged materials go into motors, wires and everything else.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.energiser.title: Energiser
codex.quest.tech2_newage.heat.text.0: Heat pipes distribute heat, solar plates collect it, the Stirling engine turns it into rotation.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.heat.text.1: The heater replaces a blaze burner under a Create boiler — instead of coal it eats heat.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.heat.title: Heat
codex.quest.tech2_newage.motor.text.0: The motor turns electricity back into rotation at an adjustable speed. The basic one gives five hundred twelve stress, the reinforced eight thousand.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.motor.text.1: Extensions behind the motor multiply its output two and three times over.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.motor.title: Motors
codex.quest.tech2_newage.reactor.text.0: Casing, reactor glass, rods, a fuel acceptor and heat vents. Each rod adds thirty degrees per tick, and that heat has to go somewhere.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.reactor.text.1: If it doesn't: meltdown. An explosion, corium where the reactor stood and radiation around it. Encase it properly and wear leather.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.reactor.title: Nuclear Reactor
codex.quest.tech2_newage.thorium.text.0: Thorium ore, crushed into radioactive thorium, sequenced into nuclear fuel.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.thorium.text.1: Thorium multiplies in the mixer: stone, clay and water double the stock. Reactor fuel can be farmed indefinitely.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.thorium.title: Thorium
codex.quest.tech2_newage.wires.text.0: A wire strings between two connectors up to sixteen blocks. Copper carries a thousand per tick, diamond eight thousand.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.wires.text.1: Create: New Age wiring looks like a real power line and is laid the same way.
codex.quest.tech2_newage.wires.title: Wires
codex.quest.tech2_petroleum.derrick.text: The derrick opens the reservoir, and the first thing it does is gush: up to two and a half buckets a tick until the upper half of the deposit is gone. That pressure never comes back, so put the tanks up before you drill.
The derrick is placed once per field and works until the field runs dry.
codex.quest.tech2_petroleum.products.tex: Asphalt makes roads you run faster on. Lubricant speeds up Immersive Engineering machines through the auto lubricator.
Napalm is for when diplomacy didn't work.
codex.quest.tech2_petroleum.pumpjack.tex: The famous nodding donkey. Once the gusher dies down, the pumpjack lifts the second half of the deposit, with no pressure behind it at all, fifteen millibuckets a tick.

Reservoirs aren't infinite, but they never quite die either: a spent oil well stays a source of six millibuckets a tick forever. Too little for a plant, enough to keep the spot on the map from becoming junk.
The seismic survey tool tells you whether a reservoir lies under this area and what kind. The Immersive Engineering core sample does the same for ore.
A reservoir is not tied to a chunk, it stretches across a whole region, and drilling blind is still pointless: over empty ground a derrick stands without a single drop.
Every survey shot eats a buckshot cartridge and reads a square sixty-five blocks on a side.
codex.quest.tech2_petroleum.survey.title: Survey
codex.quest.tech2_petroleum.tower.text.0: Oil splits into fractions: gasoline, diesel, lubricant, bitumen. Each goes its own way.
codex.quest.tech2_petroleum.tower.text.1: The flarestack burns off surplus gas so the tower doesn't stall.
codex.quest.tech2_petroleum.tower.title: Distillation Tower
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.armor.text.0: The helmet shows mobs and chests through walls, the chestplate pulls items in with a magnet and soaks up lava damage, the leggings lengthen your stride and your jump, the boots hold jet thrust.
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.armor.text.1: Upgrades are installed at the charging station and run on the same compressed air, and each one binds its own key. Sort that layout out on the ground before your first flight.
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.armor.text.2: Jet boots come in five tiers. Tier three adds builder mode, a strictly vertical climb; tier four adds stabilizers that kill your speed the moment you let go of the thrust. A separate upgrade puts an elytra in the chestplate that never spends durability.
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.armor.title: Pneumatic Armor
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.assembly.tex: A controller, a platform, a drill and a laser — a conveyor that manufactures parts to a program. Only the controller takes air; the rest feed off it.
The programs, like the board blueprint, are not craftable: drill and laser cost eight emeralds each on the Amadron tablet, the combined one fourteen.

The line is what all of this was for: a block of compressed iron under the drill gives twenty valves, and those valves under the laser give eight advanced tubes. There is no other road to tier two tubing.
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.chamber.text: A hollow cube of glass walls with a valve and an interface. Three, four or five blocks to a side, nothing but air inside. Under pressure it runs recipes found nowhere else: empty circuit boards, transistors, acid, diamonds out of coal blocks.
The chamber is also a battery: a five-by-five cube holds four hundred and thirty-two thousand millibuckets of air, enough to ride out any spike in demand.
Negative pressure inside pulls enchantments off an item and into a book. That is how you get the books for the jackhammer, which no enchanting table will touch.
It's the mod's first multiblock and its most necessary.
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.compressed.t: Drop iron ingots on the ground and set off TNT. About a fifth burns away entirely; the rest survives as compressed iron, the mod's base material.
The method is crude but works from day one and needs nothing but explosives. Later the pressure chamber does the same thing with no losses at all, and blowing up ingots stops being worth it.
One trick for later: compress blocks of iron, not ingots. Moving an item through the chamber interface costs the same either way, and a block holds nine times as much.
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.compressor.t: Burns fuel and drives air into tubes. The manometer shows pressure, and it's worth watching: an ordinary tube lives to five bar and bursts for certain past seven.

An open tube end hisses and bleeds air the faster the higher the pressure. The pneumatic wrench closes off the sides you don't want, the safety module vents the excess on its own, and the regulator module bridges networks of different tiers.
The blast is weak but the block vanishes without a drop. The check happens only while air is flowing in: a machine left over-pressured with the supply cut will not go off.
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.drone.text.0: The programmer draws the drone a task out of instruction blocks: go here, dig this, put it there, repeat.
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.drone.text.1: The GPS tool sets coordinates. Logistics drones move items around your base without a single pipe.
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.drone.title: Drone
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.elevator.tex: A pneumatic elevator rises to any height and is called by a button on each floor. Quiet, fast and without a single piston.
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.pcb.text.0: An empty board, UV exposure, an acid etch — and you have a finished board. A full exposure takes up to ten minutes and yields every board; pull them early and some come out as rejects.
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.pcb.text.1: Rejects aren't wasted: a blast furnace melts them back into empty boards.
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.pcb.text.2: One detail can stall the whole branch: the blueprint for the UV light box cannot be crafted. You order it on an Amadron tablet for eight emeralds, or buy it from a mechanic villager.
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.pcb.text.3: Boards are the heart of all the mod's electronics.
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.pcb.title: Printed Circuit Boards
codex.quest.tech2_pneumatic.plastic.text: The refinery breaks crude oil into diesel, kerosene, gasoline and LPG, and the taller the stack, the more fractions come out of a single pass. The oil comes from Immersive Petroleum wells or your own drilling.
LPG and a lump of coal in the thermopneumatic processing plant give liquid plastic; freeze it down to zero in a heat frame and you have a sheet.
Plastic goes into everything: boards, drones, armor.
codex.quest.tech2_powah.cells.text.0: The cell stores, the cable carries. The ender cell links two points without wire, the player transmitter charges everything in your pockets at range.
codex.quest.tech2_powah.cells.title: Cells and Cables
codex.quest.tech2_powah.crystals.text.0: Blazing, niotic, spirited, nitro — four crystals that set the tier of all the tech.
codex.quest.tech2_powah.crystals.text.1: Made in the orb from matching materials, and they aren't cheap.
codex.quest.tech2_powah.crystals.title: Crystals
Paste, rods and casing — everything in this mod is built from them. Plus energized steel, made in the energizing orb.
codex.quest.tech2_powah.dielectric.title: Dielectric
The orb and the rods around it turn energy into materials: energized steel, crystals, higher-tier components.
More rods, faster work. It's the mod's hub machine.
codex.quest.tech2_powah.energizing.title: Energizing Orb
The thermo generator on temperature difference, the furnator on coal, the magmator on lava, the solar panel on sunlight.
Every starter version is cheap and goes up the first evening.
codex.quest.tech2_powah.generators.title: Generators
codex.quest.tech2_powah.reactor.text.0: Uraninite is mined underground and feeds the reactor. Multiblock, quiet and very strong — but it needs cooling.
codex.quest.tech2_powah.reactor.text.1: Fuel burns slowly and the output depends on neither sun nor coal.
codex.quest.tech2_powah.reactor.title: Reactor

codex.quest.trials_early.cobble.text.0: Three stacks of cobblestone. It piles up anyway — let it be useful once.
codex.quest.trials_early.cobble.title: Stonecutter
codex.quest.trials_early.food.text.0: Thirty-two steaks or as much roast chicken. The pack's kitchen will make them pointless soon; for now — a good trade.
codex.quest.trials_early.food.title: Pantry
codex.quest.trials_early.glass.text.0: Sixty-four glass. Create asks for glass on nearly every casing — here's its payment.
codex.quest.trials_early.glass.title: Glassblower
codex.quest.trials_early.iron.reward.0: One and a half ingots per ingot turned in — ore doubling before Create
codex.quest.trials_early.iron.text.0: Thirty-two ingots. In return — what you hate spending yourself: a pickaxe with Mending lasts a long while.
codex.quest.trials_early.iron.title: First Iron
codex.quest.trials_early.leather.text.0: Sixteen leather. A backpack needs less, but the upgraded one is made of iron, and your iron's already been taken.
codex.quest.trials_early.leather.title: Tanner
codex.quest.trials_early.logs.text.0: Sixty-four logs of any oak. Trees here fall in layers, so a stack gathers faster than it seems.
codex.quest.trials_early.logs.title: Woodcutter
codex.quest.trials_late.atomic.title: Atomic Alloy
codex.quest.trials_late.disks.reward.0: Eight parts are two new disks; a wireless grid thrown in
codex.quest.trials_late.disks.title: Archivist
codex.quest.trials_late.duroplast.text.0: Thirty-two duroplast and four buckets of biodiesel.
codex.quest.trials_late.duroplast.title: Polymers
codex.quest.trials_late.electrum.text.0: Thirty-two electrum and sixty-four electrum wire.
codex.quest.trials_late.electrum.title: Conductor
codex.quest.trials_late.levitite.title: Lighter Than Air
codex.quest.trials_late.nethersteel.text: Sixteen nethersteel ingots from Big Cannons.
codex.quest.trials_late.polonium.text.0: Eight polonium and eight plutonium pellets. Proof of a working reactor and waste processing.
codex.quest.trials_late.polonium.title: Nuclear Cycle
codex.quest.trials_late.sturdy.title: Heavy Industry
codex.quest.trials_late.truadamantite.te: Sixteen truadamantite from the Kingdom of Amber.
codex.quest.trials_mid.alloy.text.0: One hundred twenty-eight andesite alloy. A mixer makes that in a couple of minutes — if you already have one.
codex.quest.trials_mid.alloy.title: Andesite River
codex.quest.trials_mid.brass.text.0: Sixty-four brass ingots. The first serious trade: in return — what the brass age can't begin without.
codex.quest.trials_mid.brass.title: Brass Standard
codex.quest.trials_mid.bread.text.0: One hundred twenty-eight bread for the colony. The MineColonies baker makes that in a day, and you get what the colony doesn't make.
codex.quest.trials_mid.bread.title: Bread Tribute
codex.quest.trials_mid.circuits.text.0: Eight advanced circuits. In return — four elite ones: a trade that skips a chemistry tier.
codex.quest.trials_mid.circuits.title: Circuitry
codex.quest.trials_mid.coke.reward.0: A second coke oven lasts the whole game
codex.quest.trials_mid.coke.text.0: One hundred twenty-eight coke and eight buckets of creosote.
codex.quest.trials_mid.coke.title: Coke Chemistry
codex.quest.trials_mid.osmium.text.0: Sixty-four osmium and thirty-two Mekanism steel.
codex.quest.trials_mid.osmium.title: Osmium Reserve
codex.quest.trials_mid.precision.text.0: Sixteen precision mechanisms. Made by hand it's long; made by a crafter line, it's a test of the line.
codex.quest.trials_mid.precision.title: Precision Work
codex.quest.trials_mid.processors.title: Silicon Valley
codex.quest.trials_mid.sheets.text.0: Sixty-four iron sheets and thirty-two copper.
codex.quest.trials_mid.sheets.title: Rolled Stock
codex.quest.trials_mid.steel_ie.text.0: Sixty-four IE steel ingots. The blast furnace manages in an evening.
codex.quest.trials_mid.steel_ie.title: Steelmaker
